Description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Description

Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Data Scientist III within the Data Science Center of Excellence.

In this role, you will help design, build, and operate the enterprise platform that enables scalable data science and AI solutions across the organization. Working at the intersection of analytics, software engineering, and cloud infrastructure, you will partner closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, production-ready capabilities that generate measurable business value.

This role combines advanced analytics with platform engineering and operational excellence. In addition to developing machine learning and AI solutions, you will contribute to the automation, orchestration, monitoring, and support of the data science platform. You will help establish engineering best practices that enable reliable, scalable, and maintainable production workloads.

As part of a multidisciplinary technical team, you will contribute to the operational health, reliability, and continuous improvement of the enterprise data science platform. Working closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Product Managers, and technical leadership, you will help ensure production solutions are scalable, resilient, and well-supported throughout their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Delivery


Design, develop, and deploy machine learning, AI, and advanced analytics solutions that address commercial and operational business needs.
Translate business requirements into scalable analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Partner with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to design technical solutions that balance business value, scalability, and maintainability.
Apply statistical analysis, machine learning, and AI techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver measurable outcomes.


Platform Engineering & Automation


Build and maintain reusable data science components, automated workflows, and production pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and AWS.
Develop workflow orchestration, deployment automation, and operational tooling that improve platform efficiency, reliability, and reduce manual effort.
Contribute to platform architecture, engineering standards, and technical best practices supporting enterprise AI solutions.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to integrate analytical solutions into production systems and enterprise data platforms.


Platform Operations & Engineering


Contribute to the operation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the enterprise data science platform.
Collaborate with the broader technical team to maintain reliable production pipelines, scheduled workflows, and deployed machine learning solutions.
Investigate production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement improvements that increase platform reliability, observability, and operational efficiency.
Participate in release activities, disaster recovery planning, and operational readiness to support resilient production systems.


Collaboration & Technical Leadership


Partner closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Product Managers, and technical leadership to design scalable, maintainable solutions.
Communicate technical concepts, solution designs, and analytical findings to both technical and business audiences.
Contribute to documentation, code quality, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices across the Data Science Center of Excellence.
Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend improvements that strengthen the team's capabilities and platform.


Requirements

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
3+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
Experience developing and deploying production data science or analytics solutions.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and AWS.
Experience building or supporting data pipelines, automated workflows, or production data platforms.
Experience with workflow orchestration, automation, or job scheduling.
Experience monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting production systems.
Experience with Git/GitHub and modern software development practices.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field and 2+ years of relevant professional experience.
Experience building recommendation systems or AI-enabled commercial solutions.
Experience with MLflow and machine learning lifecycle management.
Familiarity with Salesforce data models and CRM workflows.
Experience implementing CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or MLOps practices.
Experience supporting cloud-based analytics platforms in a production environment.
Experience working in life sciences, healthcare, or other regulated industries.

Title: AI Scientist in Oncology
Description:
IFOM, the AIRC Institute of Molecular Oncology in Milan, is seeking a talented AI scientist to develop and apply machine learning and generative AI to one of the central questions in IFOM's long-term strategic plan and one of the hardest problems in oncology: discriminating cancers destined from the onset for indolent behaviour ("born to be good") from those with aggressive behaviour ("born to be bad"), including those featuring early metastasis and resistance or relapse after therapy.

Working within IFOM's institute-wide AI programme and in close collaboration with its experimental and clinical groups, you will use machine learning and generative AI to extract mechanistic insights, biomarkers and therapeutic vulnerabilities from data generated in experimental models and in large clinical cohorts of tumour-infiltrated tissue collected at diagnosis, integrated with clinical annotation of outcome, disease evolution, and response to immunotherapy and personalised treatment, turning IFOM's rich multi-scale data into predictive, mechanistic and clinically meaningful insight.

IFOM is uniquely positioned to tackle this challenging and rewarding question thanks to the convergence of multiple top-notch research activities across the institute's groups.




Role of the AI scientist in the IFOM community




Apply models that integrate single-cell and spatial omics, genomics, epigenomics, proteomics and multidimensional immunohistochemistry, together with radiomics and pathomics, pharmacogenomic screens in patient-derived xenografts and tumoroids, animal models, and functional genetic screens using CRISPR/Cas9 technologies, to model tumour fate from diagnosis onward.
Help decode tumour fate from an initial biopsy sample, uncovering determinants of indolent vs aggressive behaviour, including how epigenetic state, dormancy and reawakening, exposure to environmental agents, host immune fitness, and tumour biomechanical properties shape disease trajectory.
Contribute to translation by turning model outputs into predictive biomarkers of aggressiveness and relapse, and into actionable hypotheses for precision therapy.
Build shared foundation models, pipelines, benchmarks and infrastructure for rigorous, reproducible use across the institute, helping IFOM's research groups converge on this shared challenge.
Work closely with computational and experimental colleagues, and contribute to mentoring junior scientists and students.




Who we are looking for

Essential: PhD in computational biology, informatics, computer science or a related field; a strong record in AI/ML for biomedicine (computational oncology, single-cell/spatial biology, digital pathology, multi-omics or foundation models); proven ability to integrate multiple data modalities; hands-on expertise in modern deep learning and ideally foundation, multimodal or spatial AI; and a genuine interest in integrating clinical and experimental datasets to interrogate features of tumour aggressiveness, early metastasis and therapy resistance;




Desirable: experience building, fine-tuning or benchmarking foundation models for pathology, genomics, imaging or single-cell data; familiarity with translational and longitudinal clinical data; a record of high-impact publication; and experience collaborating across disciplines.




What IFOM offers

A central scientific role within a flagship AI programme in a Centre of Excellence for Research, with strong scope to shape methods and analyses.

Access to rich multi-scale data, including single-cell and spatial omics, genomics, epigenomics, 3D-chromatin, advanced imaging, multidimensional IHC, radiomics and pathomics, and functional-genomic screens, supported by an established Bioinformatics Unit and top-notch imaging, genomics and proteomics platforms.

Collaboration with internationally recognized molecular and cell biologists, pathologists and clinical partners belonging to IFOM's international network, converging on IFOM's long-term strategic mission.




How to apply

To apply, please submit the following documents in a single application to recruitment@ifom.eu:




Curriculum Vitae
Short Statement (covering research interests, motivation, and relevant experience)
Technical Research Plan
Contact Details of Three Referees




Please note:

Applicants who do not meet the minimum qualifications will not be considered.




For informal enquiries, you may contact Cecilia Osera, IFOM Scientific Officer, at cecilia.osera@ifom.eu.




Inclusive environment

IFOM is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace, and we particularly welcome applications from women and underrepresented minorities to contribute to scientific excellence. IFOM is a gender-equality institute, actively supporting equal opportunities and the advancement of women in science, fostering an inclusive environment where their careers can truly thrive.




This announcement is addressed to both sexes pursuant to Laws 903/77 and 125/91 and to people of all ages and nationalities pursuant to Legislative Decrees 215/03 and 216/03.

Title: Data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Description:
Il nostro cliente è una primaria multinazionale italiana leader globale nel settore Retail & Healthcare, con una presenza capillare in oltre 25 Paesi e un network di migliaia di punti vendita a livello internazionale.

Per il potenziamento del proprio Global Center of Expertise (CoE) presso l'Headquarter di Milano, siamo alla ricerca di un Customer Intelligence & CRM Insights Sr Specialist / Manager.




Descrizione del Ruolo

La risorsa inserita sarà il punto di riferimento analitico e strategico per l'evoluzione del CRM 2.0 su scala globale, orientato all'iper-personalizzazione.

Rispondendo all'Associate Director Global CRM e lavorando all'interno di un team strutturato e dinamico, la figura opererà come Business Partner di livello globale, coordinando risorse esterne/consulenti e affiancando direttamente i Country Manager e Marketing Director delle varie filiali estere nella traduzione dei dati in leve di business.




Responsabilità Chiave

CRM 2.0 & Iper-Personalizzazione: Definire e implementare logiche di ingaggio cliente avanzate, orientate alla personalizzazione dell'esperienza e delle offerte.
Data Prep & Hands-on Coding: Curare direttamente la pulizia, la trasformazione e l'integrazione di dataset complessi da fonti eterogenee (CRM, POS, Web Analytics, Survey) tramite SQL avanzato e Python.
Modellistica Predittiva & Machine Learning: Progettare e sviluppare algoritmi di Churn Prevention, Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) e propensione al riacquisto (Repurchase / Next Best Action).
Segmentazione & Clustering: Sviluppare modelli di clustering non supervisionato per profilare la Customer Base globale.
Business Partnering & Storytelling: Tradurre analisi quantitative complesse in dashboard direzionali (Power BI/Tableau) e "raccomandazioni azionabili" per gli executive dei vari Paesi.
AI Generativa & LLM: Partecipare alla sperimentazione e all'integrazione di progetti innovativi di Generative AI applicati al CRM (es. Speech Analytics, Prompt Design).




Requisiti Richiesti

Formazione & Tracciato Professionale

Titolo di Studio:Laurea Magistrale in ambito STEM (Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica, Statistica, Data Science).
Seniority:7+ anni di esperienza in ruoli di Customer Analytics / Data Science applicati al B2C.
Background Ideale: Percorso iniziale in consulenza con successivo passaggio in aziende B2C strutturate ad alto volume di dati




Competenze Tecniche & Linguistiche

Coding: Padronanza quotidiana di SQL avanzato e Python (Pandas, PySpark, Scikit-Learn).
Data Visualization: Ottima conoscenza di Power BI o Tableau.
Lingue:Inglese Fluente (C1/C2), indispensabile per la gestione quotidiana degli stakeholder internazionali.




Soft Skills

Eccellente capacità di storytelling dei dati e presenza relazionale di fronte a interlocutori non tecnici.
Approccio fortemente hands-on unito a visione strategica.
Capacità di coordinamento di team terzi e fornitori.




Dettagli Contrattuali

Sede di lavoro: Milano (HQ).
Inquadramento: Contratto a Tempo Indeterminato, Livello Quadro.
Work Mode: Ibrido (policy aziendale che prevede 6 giorni al mese di smart working).
Pacchetto retributivo: Target indicativo RAL €65.000 – €75.000 + MBO / Variabile.

Title: AI/ML Engineer
Description:
🚀 #WEAREALTIA

ALTIA is a multidisciplinary team focused on delivering advanced data-driven solutions that generate measurable impact and enable smarter decision-making. Working across international environments, we combine analytics, artificial intelligence, and business expertise to transform data into strategic value. Our mission is to help organizations evolve through innovation, scalable data platforms, and high-quality analytical solutions, fostering continuous learning, collaboration, and technological excellence.

We are looking for a Data Scientist & AI Specialist with strong expertise in machine learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), generative AI (LLMs/RAG), and data engineering pipelines applied to environmental footprints, life-cycle assessment (LCA), and sustainability analytics to join our team in international digital transformation and scientific data management initiatives.

The role involves designing, training, and deploying ML, NLP, and generative AI models (including local/API-based LLMs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation / RAG). The specialist will build and optimize scalable data pipelines to process, clean, validate, and convert heterogeneous datasets, such as official statistics, trade data, and life-cycle inventory (LCI) databases. Additionally, the candidate will focus on implementing advanced time-series forecasting, nowcasting, and data-imputation techniques to fill missing data gaps, establishing automated anomaly detection, and ensuring strict compliance with the EU AI Act, GDPR, and AI safety principles (transparency, bias mitigation, and explainability).

In close collaboration with scientific project leads, policy officers, and technical engineering teams, the specialist will translate complex environmental and business needs into working prototypes and technical specifications. The position requires deep expertise in Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow), relational databases (PostgreSQL/SQL), GPU optimization, containerization, and reproducible model packaging using Git and Docker.

⭐ WHAT WE HAVE FOR YOU?

🚩 Remote work model (far-site delivery with occasional presence in European locations if required).

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
At Uni Systems, we are working towards turning digital visions into reality. We are continuously growing and we are looking for a professional Machine Learning Engineer to join our UniQue Ispra team.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our customers in the public sector and you will be responsible for developing new business by identifying profitable opportunities, maintaining your client portfolio by building strong, long-lasting relationships, and monitoring the progress of the projects, with the aim to provide excellent client service and added value services.

What will you be bringing to the team?

Collect business requirement and develop advanced data mining solutions or identify, assess and deploy relevant existing data mining, machine learning and business intelligence solutions, in detail:
To analyse user needs and requirements
To identify and propose alternative implementations to support user requirements
To architect a final system solution
To contribute to the implementation of the identified architecture.
To devise quality, security and architectural plans and assist in their implementation
Develop specifications and design of presentation interfaces with optimal usability/user experience; follow up with their implementation;
Identify, collect, convert and update different data types/sets in several locations;
Produces data models according to specific problems statements;
Scripting and programming;
Contribute to the design and implementation of the analytics architecture and its solution stack (including performance aspects, physical design, capacity dimensions etc...)
Write the different documentation associated with the tasks and liaise with other project teams as necessary to address cross-project interdependencies.


Requirements



What do you need to succeed in this position?

Master Degree + 3 years of relevant professional experience
At least 3 years of experience in statistical computing and data visualization using R, SAS, SPSS, STATA or equivalent platforms.
At least 2 years of experience in:
Scripting and programming using Python and JavaScript.
Database architecture and query development, covering SQL and NoSQL technologies such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB and Elasticsearch.
At least 1 year of experience in:
Using Python to collect, clean, process and analyze structured and unstructured data, with libraries such as pandas and NumPy or equivalent tools.
Applying machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) to textual data for information extraction, document classification, clustering and semantic similarity, using tools such as spaCy, scikit-learn and Sentence Transformers or equivalent technologies.
Using large language models (LLMs) for structured information extraction, classification and summarization, including prompt development and verification of outputs against source evidence.
Assessing data quality and validating analytical outputs, including comparison with human-reviewed examples, error analysis, and documentation of uncertainty and limitations.
Identifying trends and patterns, synthesizing information from multiple sources, and preparing analytical summaries, reports or briefs in English, with accurate referencing and clear presentation of findings.
Excellent knowledge of data analytics techniques and their mathematical foundations; basic knowledge of multivariate analysis and principal component analysis is desirable.
Strong background in machine learning and NLP.
Desirable expertise in one or more of the following: predictive modelling, forecasting, prescriptive analytics, simulation, sentiment analysis, topic detection, social media analytics, trend and anomaly detection, and recommendation systems.
Proficiency in business intelligence, data visualization and ETL tools, such as SAP, BusinessObjects, Tableau and Talend Open Studio.
Knowledge of web application architectures, including HTML5, CSS3, APIs and backend technologies such as .NET/C#, Node.js/Express.js and Spring Boot/Java.
Experience with Unix environments and DevOps practices, including continuous integration and delivery, automated testing, containerization and orchestration, using tools such as GitLab and OpenShift.
Good oral and written communication skills in English.

Title: AI Scientist
Description:
Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 11.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious AI Scientist to build the reusable AI foundations and agentic scientific systems that power the group’s research across human genetics, multimodal biology, and disease.

Your mission

As AI Scientist, you will develop next-generation AI systems at the interface of ambitious biological research and frontier artificial intelligence, using population-scale genetics and multimodal biomedical data to uncover mechanisms of human disease.

You will turn methods and models emerging from this research into robust, reusable AI capabilities—including foundation models, multimodal representation learning, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, and scalable research software—that can accelerate discovery across multiple projects.

A longer-term goal is to develop AI systems that increasingly act as scientific collaborators: connecting evidence across biological scales, proposing testable hypotheses, identifying informative analyses, and working alongside researchers to accelerate iterative cycles of biological discovery.

Your work will combine methodological innovation, biological discovery, and scientific software development at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and human genetics. You will have substantial scientific and technical ownership, with the opportunity to help shape the group’s technical AI architecture while leading and contributing to high-impact scientific publications, open-source software, and reusable research capabilities.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:


Developing next-generation AI methods through ambitious biological research.
Building foundation models, multimodal representation learning approaches, and agentic AI systems for scientific discovery.
Turning scientific advances into robust, benchmarked, and reusable AI capabilities that accelerate discovery across multiple research projects.
Building scalable research software and AI workflows for large and heterogeneous scientific datasets.
Shaping the future of AI for science through high-impact publications, open-source software, international collaborations, and entrepreneurial initiatives.


Human Technopole supports career development through training, mentoring and dedicated learning opportunities.

Essential

What you'll bring


PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative discipline, or expected completion within the next six months.
At least 4 years of relevant research experience by the start of the position, including doctoral research.
Strong track record of scientific output in AI, machine learning, computational biology, or biomedicine, demonstrating independent methodological or technical contributions through publications, open-source software, models, or comparable research outputs.
Excellent programming and software engineering skills in Python, with experience building scalable and maintainable research software, model-training workflows, or AI systems.
Strong expertise in modern machine learning and AI, with demonstrated ability to design, develop, and critically evaluate advanced methods for challenging research problems.
Experience with modern software engineering and computational research practices, including version control, testing, documentation, reproducibility, and large-scale GPU or HPC environments.


Preferred


Industry or applied R&D experience in roles such as AI/ML architect, research scientist, machine learning scientist, or equivalent positions with substantial technical ownership.
Experience developing foundation models or other large-scale AI systems for scientific or biomedical applications.
Experience developing or applying LLM-based agents and agentic workflows for scientific or technical tasks, including analysis, information integration, automation, or hypothesis generation.
Experience integrating multimodal biomedical datasets, including molecular, imaging, clinical, or population-scale data.
Experience leading collaborative software projects and contributing to open-source scientific software or models.
Experience with workflow management, containerisation, and scalable GPU/HPC computing.
Familiarity with human genetics and computational biology is advantageous but not required.
Experience applying AI within drug discovery, translational research, or related biomedical pipelines is an advantage.


Organizational and social skills


Strong analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
Ability to work independently while thriving in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment.
Excellent communication and scientific writing skills.
Creativity, intellectual humility, and enthusiasm for tackling challenging biological questions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to take ownership of ambitious research projects.


At HT, your discoveries contribute to a global effort to improve human health.

Why Human Technopole

HT offers an international and dynamic workplace, competitive welfare provisions, flexible working policies and relocation support. Candidates moving to Italy may benefit from attractive tax benefits. We promote work–life balance and provide parental support initiatives.

Title: Advisory Analytics Manager - EMEA
Description:
Advisory Analytics Manager – EMEA

Aon exists to build decisions for the better — safeguarding and enriching the lives of people around the world. Our colleagues provide our clients in over 120 countries with advice and solutions that give them the clearness and confidence to make better decisions to protect and grow their business.

Our Analytics Team helps organisations make better workforce decisions by applying quantitative methods, statistical analysis, and sophisticated people analytics across human capital, compensation, and talent topics. Part of our work is supporting clients on compensation fairness, clearness in remuneration, and reward equity. We also help HR professionals and business leaders understand broader workforce dynamics and link talent outcomes to business performance.

Our division is a fast-growing area of advisory work: we combine Aon’s proprietary datasets with client data to answer strategic questions using meticulous analytical techniques, including pay equity modelling, segmentation, benchmarking, predictive modelling, driver analysis, and workforce diagnostics related to reward, talent acquisition, deployment, retention, workforce planning, and business performance.

Core Responsibilities


Interrogate large, sophisticated, and often imperfect client and proprietary datasets to identify workforce, reward, and talent patterns, including potential pay equity issues, data anomalies, and opportunities for evidence-based insight.
Lead or run elaborate analytics engagements from problem definition and data specification through data preparation, methodology selection, model development, validation, and interpretation of results across topics such as pay equity, pay transparency, workforce planning, reward analytics, and predictive people analytics.
Synthesise sophisticated quantitative outputs into clear narratives, translating statistical findings, pay equity diagnostics, model results, and benchmark comparisons into practical implications and recommendations for HR and organizational decision-makers.
Build analytically robust solutions to client issues by defining the data strategy, analytical framework, control factors where relevant, modelling approach, and required outputs, while balancing technical depth with commercial feasibility.
Demonstrate commercial leadership by understanding and interpreting client requirements related to compensation fairness, incentives, employee base, and people analytics. Craft these problems into compelling client proposals.


Qualifications And Experience That Will Lead To Success

As an Analytics Manager, your skills and experience will ideally include:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Mathematics; postgraduate training in analytics is profitable.
Experience with statistical methods and analytical techniques, such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, segmentation, trend analysis.
Hands-on experience working with large and complicated HR, reward, compensation, and workforce datasets, ideally using Python, R, SQL, or analogous tools for data manipulation, analysis, and quality assurance.
Significant experience delivering analytical work in consulting and/or corporate analytics environments, ideally in pay equity, compensation, workforce, HR, or people analytics, with exposure to sophisticated client datasets and multi-country contexts.
Strong capability in data visualisation, dashboarding, and insight communication, including tools such as Tableau or Power BI, demonstrating skill in distilling pay equity, reward, and workforce analyses into clear and decision-useful outputs.
A meticulous and curious analytical mind, with strong attention to detail, good judgement on data limitations, and a proactive approach to solving technically and commercially intricate problems.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical methods, findings, and limitations clearly to non-technical interested parties and senior audiences.


The expected salary for the role is within an indicative range of €46,300.00 - €69,500.00, based

on the candidate's experience and seniority.

Title: Catastrophe Modeling Lead
Description:
Location: Milano, Trieste.




Within the Group Climate Hub, we are looking for a proactive and experienced professional to join the Catastrophe Modeling team. The role will have direct responsibility for managing and coordinating catastrophe modeling activities for a defined portfolio perimeter, acting as a key reference point for internal and external stakeholders and contributing to strategic risk management and reinsurance decisions.




Key responsibilities of the role will include:

Lead and directly manage the end-to-end catastrophe modeling process for the assigned perimeter, ensuring the timely production, validation and interpretation of modeling results and exposure analyses
Drive the evaluation, testing, selection and implementation of catastrophe models, developing recommendations and presenting conclusions to support reinsurance, risk management and business decisions
Perform and coordinate complex exposure management analyses, identifying key risk drivers, emerging trends and portfolio optimization opportunities
Act as the primary point of contact for Group Business Units on catastrophe modeling topics, providing technical guidance and ensuring consistency of methodologies, assumptions and outputs across the Group
Manage relationships with external stakeholders, including model vendors, brokers and reinsurers, overseeing model releases, calibration activities and technical discussions
Take ownership of the delivery of catastrophe modeling outputs and related reporting, ensuring quality, robustness and adherence to internal governance requirements
Contribute to the definition and evolution of catastrophe modeling methodologies, processes and best practices, promoting innovation and continuous improvement
Support knowledge sharing and capability development across the Group, providing technical mentoring and acting as a reference expert within the catastrophe modeling community
Collaborate with Reinsurance, Risk Management and other Climate Hub functions on activities including risk assessment, Nat Cat budgeting, pricing support and accumulation analyses.




Requirements

Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in catastrophe modeling gained in an insurance company, broker, reinsurer or model vendor
Master’s degree in quantitative subjects (Natural Sciences, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics or related fields)
Programming skills (SQL, Python, R)
Proficient in English and Italian. Other European foreign language such as French, German, Spanish will be considered a plus.




Soft Skills:

Strong leadership and organizational skills
Proven ability in managing effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Commitment to knowledge sharing and capability building within the team
Experience in leading cross-functional projects and working with challenging deadlines
Proactive, ownership-driven and result-oriented approach
Combining good analytical and relational/communication skills
Open to innovation and change.




What we offer

We offer employment at Funzionario level with the relevant salary, in accordance with the CCNL ANIA for non-executive employees and the Generali Group Company Agreement.

Gross annual salary ranging between 57K€ and 70K€. The final offer will be aligned with the candidate’s professional experience, technical and soft skills relevant to the role, and may include an individual variable component.




We also offer

Smart working and flexible hours
Corporate welfare system
Meal vouchers
Supplementary health insurance and discounted insurance policies
Well-being initiatives
Training and development
Structured continuous learning paths (technical and managerial)
Career development programs within the Group
Access to learning platforms and internal mobility opportunities, including international assignments.




Why work with us

Joining Generali means becoming part of an international Group with a strong heritage and a forward-looking vision, where people are at the center of our sustainable growth strategy.

We foster a responsible, inclusive, and innovation-driven work environment, where everyone can contribute to creating value for customers, society, and the communities in which we operate. We believe that diversity, equity and inclusion are essential to building a stronger culture and driving sustainable growth.

At Generali, you will find opportunities to grow through continuous learning, career development paths, and internal mobility across the Group. We recognize talent and merit, and support flexibility as a key enabler of well-being and a sustainable work-life balance.

Working with us means sharing strong values and taking on meaningful challenges together to build a safer and more sustainable future every day.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Generali evaluates all applications based exclusively on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including skills, experience and potential, ensuring fairness and transparency throughout the selection process.




Company Profile

Generali Group Head Office is the guidelining unit of the Generali Group, one of the largest global insurance and asset management providers. Established in 1831, Generali is present in over 50 countries in the world, with a total premium income of € 82.5 billion in 2023. Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Company Description

Moviri started as a research spinoff at Politecnico of Milan and was incubated at its startup accelerator.

Data and experimentation are part of our DNA: it is for this reason that we continuously focus on research, emerging ideas, and new technologies, routinely partnering with top academic and engineering research institutions.

Moviri Consulting is the first company of Moviri and its foundation. Moviri’s professionals use data, software, and insights to solve substantial business challenges for Fortune 500 corporations, multinational banks, global media conglomerates and some of the most respected brands in a variety of industries. The Moviri Consulting Performance Engineering team optimizes performance of IT systems to make them responsive, infinitely scalable, reliable, resilient and cost-effective.




What you'll do

As part of our AI Labs team, you'll contribute to projects ranging from traditional Machine Learning to the latest Generative AI applications.




Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and developing solutions based on Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI.
Building data pipelines for data collection, processing, and validation across multiple sources.
Developing, training, and optimizing advanced models for real-world use cases.
Deploying AI models and applications into production environments, ensuring reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to transform business challenges into impactful technology solutions.
Exploring new frameworks, tools, and methodologies while contributing to the continuous evolution of the team’s capabilities.
Working with cutting-edge technologies in Generative AI, Natural Language Processing, and Advanced Analytics.




Who we're looking for

We are seeking a curious, proactive employee with a genuine passion for technology.




Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM field.
Experience in software development and programming using Python, Java, C++, R, or similar languages.
Familiarity with Data Science and Machine Learning frameworks such as Pandas, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, Matplotlib, and FastAPI.
Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Git, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD practices.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Knowledge of Big Data ecosystems, including Spark and Hadoop.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
Interest in or experience with Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, and Generative AI solutions.




Why Moviri is your place

Moviri is where you can truly grow, challenge yourself, and make an impact.




Work on meaningful projects: you'll contribute to innovative initiatives for leading international organizations, applying AI to real-world challenges with measurable impact.




Grow fast: we invest in our people. You'll learn from experienced professionals, work with emerging technologies, and continuously develop both technical and consulting skills.




Flexibility and trust: we believe autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. We offer a hybrid working model and empower our people to take ownership of their work and make an impact.




Tech Your Way: great ideas come from people who have the right tools to bring them to life. Whether you're a Mac or Windows enthusiast, you'll be free to choose the setup that best supports the way you create, build, and innovate.




Rewards & Benefits: we offer a competitive compensation package, with a salary range between €27,000 and €32,000 depending on experience and qualifications, along with Satispay meal vouchers and a yearly welfare allowance of €600. As part of the overall compensation package, employees may also be eligible for an annual performance-based bonus (MBO), reflecting both individual contribution and company performance.




Fresh Ideas, Fresh Fruit: Well-being matters too. That's why, through our partnership with Cortilia, we provide fresh fruit in the office every week, supporting healthy habits and a more sustainable workplace.




We also believe that great workplaces are built through shared experiences. Throughout the year, we organize team-building activities, company events, and informal gatherings (Beer Friday, Company Parties...) creating opportunities to connect, collaborate, and celebrate together.




Location: Milan or Padua (Italy), with a hybrid working model.




The selection process

We're looking for people who can grow and make a meaningful impact over time. That's why our selection process is designed to assess not only technical skills, but also potential, curiosity, and problem-solving ability.




The process may include multiple stages, such as technical interviews and discussions with team members. Every application is reviewed carefully, and we strive to provide a transparent and respectful experience for all candidates.




Technology evolves constantly, and nobody knows everything. What matters most is the willingness to learn, challenge yourself, and contribute with curiosity, accountability, and a collaborative mindset.




Join us

If you'd like to work on cutting-edge AI projects, grow in a collaborative environment, and help build innovative solutions used in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Senior Biostatistician
Description:
At Recordati, we are united by a clear purpose: unlocking the full potential of life. With a century of history behind us, we are building the next chapter of our journey, continuing to grow while keeping patients at the centre of all we do.

What drives us is a shared belief that health, and the opportunity to live life to the full, should be within reach for everyone. This brings energy to our work, shaping how we support each other and show up every day. Our values – Better Together, Never Settle and Always Deliver – reflect this mindset, helping us to keep improving and make a meaningful difference.

Above all, these values bring to life our promise to everyone at Recordati, you can unlock your full potential. We know that people thrive when they can be themselves, are trusted and supported, and are given the opportunity to grow and make a meaningful contribution.

Are you ready to unlock your full potential?

Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Senior Biostatistician to provide expert methodological support across the development portfolio. The role will ensure the robust management, analysis and interpretation of data from studies of new and marketed medicines conducted directly or through CROs, including integrated and pooled analyses. The successful candidate will contribute to statistical strategy, promote contemporary methods and technologies, and support consistently high statistical standards across R&D.

Key Responsibilities

You will collaborate closely with Therapeutic Area management to define robust statistical approaches to clinical trials, translate scientific questions into evidence plans and support the operational requirements of clinical development programmes.

You will play an influential role in cross-functional Project Teams, providing clear statistical direction, constructively challenging assumptions and enabling evidence-based decisions throughout the development lifecycle.

You will be accountable, directly or through oversight, for high-quality statistical input to major documents, including clinical development plans, protocols, data management plans, case report forms, clinical study reports, integrated summaries of safety and efficacy, scientific publications and external data presentations. You will partner with Medical Writing and other functions to ensure scientific clarity, consistency and regulatory readiness.

You will lead or supervise the development of statistical analysis plans and the production of tables, figures and listings, ensuring that approaches are scientifically rigorous, efficient and fit for purpose.

You will provide expert review of clinical study protocols and statistical and data management documents, setting a high standard for quality and consistency.

You will lead complex analyses and interpretation of results from clinical studies, integrated analyses and meta-analyses, communicating implications clearly to cross-functional and senior stakeholders.

You will maintain sufficient hands-on SAS expertise to perform or critically review statistical analyses, tables, figures and listings, while effectively overseeing programming delivered by internal or external partners.

You will build effective partnerships with Medical and Clinical functions to plan analyses, interpret study data and resolve complex methodological questions.

You will partner with R&D Quality Assurance in audits of CROs and study sites and help ensure the integrity, traceability and quality of statistical analyses.

You will collaborate with Drug Safety on the statistical evaluation of pharmacovigilance data, including signal detection activities.

You will contribute to the development, implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of divisional SOPs, standards and guidelines.

You will provide risk-based oversight of CRO statistical deliverables, proactively managing quality, timelines, dependencies and escalation of issues.

You will champion the evaluation and responsible adoption of new statistical methods, tools and technologies, share expertise and contribute to consistent, high-quality statistical practices across the function.

Required Education

Advanced degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics or a closely related quantitative discipline; a PhD is advantageous but not essential.

Required Skills And Experience

Typically 10 or more years of progressive biostatistics experience in the pharmaceutical industry, biotechnology sector or a CRO, with substantial responsibility for clinical development programmes.

You bring deep expertise in theoretical and applied statistics and a strong command of regulatory expectations in pharmaceutical development. You have significant experience contributing to major regulatory submissions, such as NDA, MAA or equivalent dossiers, and responding to health authority questions.

Technical Competencies

You have strong working knowledge of GCP, CDISC standards and relevant regulatory guidance, with a consistent focus on data integrity and reproducibility.

You have advanced SAS skills and the judgement to select, explain and defend appropriate statistical methods. Experience with additional statistical technologies and evolving analytical approaches is an advantage

Required Behaviours And Competencies

You are a credible and collaborative senior professional who communicates complex concepts with clarity and influence. You are comfortable operating with autonomy, making sound judgements, navigating ambiguity and engaging effectively at all levels of the organisation. You contribute positively to team effectiveness through expertise, constructive challenge and knowledge sharing.

Required Languages

Fluent written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage in an international environment.

Salary

Gross Annual Salary starting from: 65.000€

Please note: The salary indicated in this posting complies with local pay transparency regulations for Italian employment contracts. Final offers will be tailored to the successful candidate's experience, professional expertise, and interview journey, while ensuring internal equity. At Recordati, we are committed to a comprehensive, fair, and competitive remuneration system; a full overview of your total rewards package will be shared and discussed with you during the recruiting process.

At Recordati we believe in people! Inspired by our purpose - unlocking the full potential of life - we are committed to creating a diverse environment and cultivating a culture of inclusion. We strive to continually lead with our values and beliefs, enabling our employees to bring their whole selves to work and develop their potential.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, develop and reward without regard to, amongst others, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical or mental ability, race, ethnicity, political or religious belief.

If you are looking to join a company where you can try new things, speak openly, and be bold, we invite you to apply today.

Title: Machine Learning & AI Engineer
Description:
Alkemy Group supporta le aziende nell’innovare la relazione con i propri clienti attraverso dati, tecnologia, AI, media, design e creatività, dando vita a esperienze che superano i confini tra fisico e digitale.




Alkemy Group si articola in tre aree di eccellenza:

[Alkemy] Data.Tech.AI, specializzata nell’evoluzione di modelli di business potenziati dalla tecnologia e abilitati dall’AI
[Alkemy] Retail Tech, focalizzata su software e tecnologia per il mondo Retail
[Alkemy]+, che integra creatività, comunicazione, design, media e commerce




A queste si affianca Alkemy Nova, la practice che valorizza trasversalmente l’intero ecosistema, con un focus sull’evoluzione dei modelli di customer engagement e loyalty.

Il Gruppo nasce con il supporto di FSI – il principale fondo europeo di investimento dedicato alla crescita di imprese italiane – dall’unione di realtà leader nei rispettivi ambiti: Alkemy, COSMIC, Konvergence, Retex e Tier 1.

Con sede a Milano, oltre 2.000 professionisti e una presenza consolidata in Italia e Spagna, Alkemy Group supporta un portfolio di oltre 1.000 clienti in diversi mercati: Financial Services, Utility, Retail, Fashion & Luxury, Healthcare, Industrial, Telco, Sport & Media.







Cerchiamo un Machine Learning & AI Engineer capace di seguire il dato lungo tutto il percorso: dalla domanda di business ai dataset, dai modelli al loro funzionamento in produzione.

È un ruolo a spettro ampio più che specialistico. Chi lo ricopre scrive codice Python, interroga e modella i dati in SQL, costruisce pipeline, addestra modelli e ne cura il rilascio – muovendosi con disinvoltura tra analisi, machine learning e data engineering. Lavorerai in un team di Advanced Analytics e MLOps su clienti enterprise in settori diversi, dal telco al banking, dall’automotive alle utility.




Cosa farai




Sviluppare in Python analisi, modelli e componenti riutilizzabili.
Interrogare e modellare i dati in SQL: query complesse, data modeling, costruzione di customer table / ABT.
Preparare i dati: data cleaning, integrazione da fonti eterogenee, trasformazione e feature engineering.
Sviluppare modelli di machine learning – regressione, clustering, modelli ad alberi, reti neurali – partendo da analisi esplorativa e descrittiva.
Costruire data pipeline e orchestrarle con Airflow, fino al deployment dei modelli in produzione.
Definire KPI e metriche che rendano misurabile il risultato, e restituirlo con visualizzazioni e reportistica leggibili dal cliente.
Presidiare le attività di progetto e collaborare con data scientist, data engineer e referenti di business.







Competenze richieste




Data engineering: data cleaning, data integration, data modeling, sviluppo di data pipeline, data transformation, programmazione avanzata su database, deployment e messa in produzione.
Data science e machine learning: analisi esplorativa, feature engineering, customer table / ABT, regressione, cluster analysis, modelli ad alberi (Random Forest, boosting), reti neurali e deployment dei modelli.
BI e analytics: querying di database, definizione di KPI e metriche, analisi descrittiva, data visualization e reportistica.
Strumenti e MLOps: Git, orchestrazione con Airflow, batch scripting, AWS Lambda, formati di interscambio dati web, ambienti Windows.
Agentic AI: conoscenza dei pattern ad agenti e dei loro casi d’uso.
Gestione delle attività di progetto: autonomia nella pianificazione e nel presidio delle consegne.
Python: sviluppo di analisi e modelli su progetti reali, non solo notebook esplorativi.
SQL: padronanza reale del linguaggio e dell’interrogazione dei dati.




Saranno considerati un plus:




Servizi dati su AWS: Athena, Glue ETL, Redshift.
GenAI: integrazione di LLM via API, strumenti open (vLLM, Ollama), RAG, prompting.
NLP e trattamento del linguaggio naturale.
CI/CD, Docker, test driven development.







Anni di esperienza: 3 – 5 anni

Sede: Milano

Area: Data & AI




COSA OFFRIAMO




In Alkemy ci impegniamo costantemente nel creare le migliori condizioni affinché tutte le nostre persone sentano di poter esprimere al meglio il proprio valore ed il proprio talento - e possano sentire Alkemy come casa propria - indipendentemente da genere, età, nazionalità, orientamento sessuale e religioso.

Siamo da sempre profondamente convinti che un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo che valorizzi tutte le diversità sia non solo un imperativo valoriale, ma un fattore critico di successo per il nostro business. Aggreghiamo sotto lo stesso tetto persone con professionalità e background molto diversi e da sempre promuoviamo una cultura di condivisione e crescita continua.

Eccellenza, Passione, Integrità e Concretezza sono i valori fondanti di Alkemy, che tutti noi condividiamo e che ci guidano nel realizzare la nostra mission.

I valori Alkemy definiscono la nostra identità e sono alla base della nostra cultura organizzativa, indirizzano i nostri comportamenti nei confronti di tutte le nostre persone e dei nostri clienti, costruendo evolutivamente il nostro approccio al business.




In conformità alle disposizioni del D.Lgs. 96/2026 in materia di trasparenza retributiva, la RAL prevista per la posizione è compresa tra € 37.000 e € 47.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere e in relazione al livello della posizione e al CCNL applicato.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.




I profili ritenuti in linea verranno contattati entro 20 giorni. Non saranno valutate candidature sprovviste di cv completo allegato. I dati dei candidati verranno trattati ai sensi dell’Informativa Privacy sempre consultabile sul nostro sito alkemy.com.

Title: Postdoc in Statistical Genetics Casale Group
Description:
Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 04.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious Postdoc in Statistical Genetics to shape our strategy for using human genetics as a causal anchor to understand disease mechanisms across biological scales.

Your mission

As Postdoc in Statistical Genetics, you will develop computational methods that connect human genetic variation to biological function. Using population-scale human genetics together with single-cell, spatial, and multimodal molecular data, you will identify the cells, cellular states, and biological programs through which genetic variation influences disease.

Your work will sit at the intersection of statistical genetics, machine learning, and mechanistic biology, with opportunities to lead methodological innovation and drive high-impact biological discoveries.

The role will give you access to population-scale human genetics, rich multimodal molecular and clinical datasets, and world-class AI and experimental research environments. This combination provides a unique foundation for ambitious research and enables biological questions to be explored at unprecedented scale.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:


Developing next-generation methods integrating human genetics and multimodal biology.
Driving biological discovery across population-scale, molecular, and clinical data.
Building an internationally recognized research profile through top publications and conferences.
Shaping the future of AI for science across academia, industry, and entrepreneurship.


Essential

The chance to build a better future is right in front of you

Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions. When you join the Financial Risk team in Milan , you are going to work on Credit Risk Modelling projects, for top-tier clients in the Financial Services sector.

developing models for the quantification of the main credit risk parameters (PD, LGD and EAD) for management and regulatory purposes, in line with Basel regulations;
assisting clients with stress test;

restructuring of derivative portfolios and development of the related financial models.


Skills

a specialist degree (graduate or nearing completion) in business, statistics, engineering, mathematics or any other quantitative faculty;
knowledge of programming software and languages (Python, SAS, R, Matlab and Stata);
excellent knowledge of Italian and English, preferably with study and/or work experience abroad;
excellent problem-solving skills and an innate ability to take initiative;
good interpersonal and teamwork skills.

Join us!

Title: Data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Title: Data & AI Consultant - New Graduate
Description:
Vorresti iniziare la tua carriera professionale in un contesto multinazionale, altamente specializzato ed innovativo?

Stiamo ricercando profili neolaureati in Fisica, Matematica, Statistica, Data Science, Ingegneria Matematica, Ingegneria Fisica o discipline quantitative affini per il nostro team di consulenza in ambito Data & Artificial Intelligence.

Il/la candidato/a lavorerà su progetti di alto profilo in ambito Data & Artificial Intelligence, contribuendo all’analisi e valorizzazione dei dati, alla progettazione di soluzioni di Machine Learning e Intelligenza Artificiale e alla realizzazione di iniziative di trasformazione data-driven, con l’obiettivo di generare valore concreto per clienti e organizzazioni.

Analizzare dataset complessi, individuando pattern, correlazioni e insight utili al business e ai processi decisionali.
Contribuire alla preparazione, trasformazione e qualità dei dati necessari alle analisi e ai modelli.
Supportare lo sviluppo e la sperimentazione di modelli di Machine Learning, AI generativa e soluzioni data-driven.
Collaborare alla progettazione di prototipi e use case, traducendo problemi complessi in approcci quantitativi e implementabili.
Lavorare con team multidisciplinari, contribuendo alla raccolta dei requisiti, alla validazione dei risultati e alla presentazione degli insight.
Documentare analisi, modelli e risultati in modo chiaro, strutturato e riproducibile.

Laurea magistrale, conseguita o in fase di conseguimento, in Fisica, Matematica, Statistica, Data Science, Ingegneria Matematica, Ingegneria Fisica o discipline quantitative affini.
Solida preparazione in matematica, statistica, probabilità e metodi quantitativi.
Conoscenza di almeno un linguaggio di programmazione per l’analisi dei dati, preferibilmente Python.
Capacità di affrontare problemi complessi con approccio analitico, strutturato e orientato alla sperimentazione.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
Attitudine al lavoro in team, curiosità, capacità di apprendimento e interesse concreto per Data & Artificial Intelligence.



Nice To Have


Conoscenza di SQL e dei principali concetti di database e data processing.
Esperienza, anche accademica, con librerie e framework di Machine Learning/Data Science.
Conoscenza di base di Large Language Model, Generative AI o sistemi agentici.
Familiarità con piattaforme cloud e strumenti per l’analisi o la visualizzazione dei dati.
Tesi, project work, hackathon o progetti personali su dati, Machine Learning o Intelligenza Artificiale.



Sede di lavoro

Milano, Roma, Napoli, Bari. P ossibilità di modalità di lavoro Ibrida (Smart Working).

Entra a far parte di un’azienda globale, leader nei servizi di business e tecnologici, che ascolta la tua voce e riconosce il valore del tuo lavoro. Collaborerai con clienti, partner e colleghi di tutto il mondo per creare soluzioni innovative capaci di avere un impatto reale sulla società. Qui potrai sviluppare nuove competenze e ampliare il tuo network.

Title: CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & CRM INSIGHTS SR SPECIALIST
Description:
Il nostro cliente è una primaria multinazionale italiana leader globale nel settore Retail & Healthcare, con una presenza capillare in oltre 25 Paesi e un network di migliaia di punti vendita a livello internazionale.

Per il potenziamento del proprio Global Center of Expertise (CoE) presso l'Headquarter di Milano, siamo alla ricerca di un Customer Intelligence & CRM Insights Sr Specialist / Manager.




Descrizione del Ruolo

La risorsa inserita sarà il punto di riferimento analitico e strategico per l'evoluzione del CRM 2.0 su scala globale, orientato all'iper-personalizzazione.

Rispondendo all'Associate Director Global CRM e lavorando all'interno di un team strutturato e dinamico, la figura opererà come Business Partner di livello globale, coordinando risorse esterne/consulenti e affiancando direttamente i Country Manager e Marketing Director delle varie filiali estere nella traduzione dei dati in leve di business.




Responsabilità Chiave

CRM 2.0 & Iper-Personalizzazione: Definire e implementare logiche di ingaggio cliente avanzate, orientate alla personalizzazione dell'esperienza e delle offerte.
Data Prep & Hands-on Coding: Curare direttamente la pulizia, la trasformazione e l'integrazione di dataset complessi da fonti eterogenee (CRM, POS, Web Analytics, Survey) tramite SQL avanzato e Python.
Modellistica Predittiva & Machine Learning: Progettare e sviluppare algoritmi di Churn Prevention, Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) e propensione al riacquisto (Repurchase / Next Best Action).
Segmentazione & Clustering: Sviluppare modelli di clustering non supervisionato per profilare la Customer Base globale.
Business Partnering & Storytelling: Tradurre analisi quantitative complesse in dashboard direzionali (Power BI/Tableau) e "raccomandazioni azionabili" per gli executive dei vari Paesi.
AI Generativa & LLM: Partecipare alla sperimentazione e all'integrazione di progetti innovativi di Generative AI applicati al CRM (es. Speech Analytics, Prompt Design).




Requisiti Richiesti

Formazione & Tracciato Professionale

Titolo di Studio:Laurea Magistrale in ambito STEM (Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica, Statistica, Data Science).
Seniority:7+ anni di esperienza in ruoli di Customer Analytics / Data Science applicati al B2C.
Background Ideale: Percorso iniziale in consulenza con successivo passaggio in aziende B2C strutturate ad alto volume di dati




Competenze Tecniche & Linguistiche

Coding: Padronanza quotidiana di SQL avanzato e Python (Pandas, PySpark, Scikit-Learn).
Data Visualization: Ottima conoscenza di Power BI o Tableau.
Lingue:Inglese Fluente (C1/C2), indispensabile per la gestione quotidiana degli stakeholder internazionali.




Soft Skills

Eccellente capacità di storytelling dei dati e presenza relazionale di fronte a interlocutori non tecnici.
Approccio fortemente hands-on unito a visione strategica.
Capacità di coordinamento di team terzi e fornitori.




Dettagli Contrattuali

Sede di lavoro: Milano (HQ).
Inquadramento: Contratto a Tempo Indeterminato, Livello Quadro.
Work Mode: Ibrido (policy aziendale che prevede 6 giorni al mese di smart working).
Pacchetto retributivo: Target indicativo RAL €65.000 – €75.000 + MBO / Variabile.
