Title: Risk Analytics & Data Science Senior Consultant - Risk Consulting
Description:
Risk Analytics & Data Science Senior Consultant – Risk Consulting

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In un contesto in cui l'intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo di lavorare, crediamo che il vero valore nasca dalla capacità delle persone di interpretare la complessità, costruire relazioni di fiducia e trasformare le opportunità tecnologiche in impatto concreto per clienti, organizzazioni e società.

Perché candidarsi in EY?

Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:


Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto.
Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita.
Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali.
Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta;
Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.
Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.


Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi?

Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un/una Risk Analytics & Data Science Senior Consultant!

Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire in un team specializzato lato Enterprise Risk, con competenze verticali su Business Intelligence, Data Science e Risk Analytics, ed esperienza nell'applicazione di metodologie analitiche avanzate per supportare il monitoraggio e la gestione dei rischi aziendali. La figura sarà coinvolta nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni data-driven a supporto dei processi decisionali, combinando competenze quantitative, capacità di analisi e conoscenza dei principali framework di Risk & Compliance Management.

Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:


definizione, monitoraggio e gestione di KPI e Key Risk Indicators (KRI) evoluti;
sviluppo di indicatori predittivi ed Early Warning Systems per il monitoraggio continuo dei rischi;
costruzione di modelli di scoring, classificazione e valutazione del rischio.
realizzazione di dashboard direzionali e strumenti di Business Intelligence a supporto delle decisioni manageriali;
sviluppo di modelli analitici avanzati basati su tecniche statistiche, Machine Learning e Predictive Analytics;
analisi delle relazioni tra rischi mediante approcci di Risk Network Analysis e Graph Analytics;
collaborazione con stakeholder business, Risk e Compliance per tradurre esigenze operative in modelli quantitativi e strumenti analitici;
sviluppo e manutenzione di data pipeline e processi automatizzati per l'elaborazione e l'analisi dei dati;


Per cominciare, cerchiamo un professionista senior che abbia le seguenti competenze tecniche e personali:


esperienza di 2/3 anni nella progettazione di dashboard executive, nello sviluppo di modelli predittivi, forecasting, anomaly detection e sistemi decisionali data-driven.
buone conoscenze lato BI & Data Visualization, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics e modelli probabilistici; ottima conoscenza di Python e SQL
capacità di tradurre esigenze di Risk e Compliance Management in modelli quantitativi e strumenti operativi fruibili dal business.
costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze con piattaforme SAS o ambienti di sviluppo analitico avanzati similari.
costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze con strumenti ETL quali IBM DataStage, Informatica o soluzioni equivalenti per la realizzazione di data pipeline automatizzate.
costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze maturate in contesti di Risk Management, Fraud Management, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) o AI Governance.


In EY potrai:


Accelerare le tue competenze: grazie a programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro e a strumenti AI che automatizzano attività ripetitive, potrai dedicare più tempo all'analisi, alla consulenza, all'innovazione e alla costruzione di relazioni professionali ad alto impatto.
Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: lavora in team internazionali e multidisciplinari, confrontandoti con prospettive diverse e contribuendo a sviluppare soluzioni che combinano tecnologia, competenze specialistiche e intuizione umana.
Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.


Avrai infine l’opportunità di:


accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
partecipare a programmi di leadership.


Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 33.000€ e 44.000€, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione. Per la specifica posizione è previsto un bonus al raggiungimento di obiettivi preventivamente comunicati e concordati.

In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico: le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.

Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in. Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.

Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.

EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world

In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In un contesto in cui l'intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo di lavorare, crediamo che il vero valore nasca dalla capacità delle persone di interpretare la complessità, costruire relazioni di fiducia e trasformare le opportunità tecnologiche in impatto concreto per clienti, organizzazioni e società.

Perché candidarsi in EY?

Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:

  • Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto.
  • Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita.
  • Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali.
  • Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta;
  • Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.
  • Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.

Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi?

Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un/una Risk Analytics & Data Science Senior Consultant!

Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire in un team specializzato lato Enterprise Risk, con competenze verticali su Business Intelligence, Data Science e Risk Analytics, ed esperienza nell'applicazione di metodologie analitiche avanzate per supportare il monitoraggio e la gestione dei rischi aziendali. La figura sarà coinvolta nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni data-driven a supporto dei processi decisionali, combinando competenze quantitative, capacità di analisi e conoscenza dei principali framework di Risk & Compliance Management.

Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:

  • definizione, monitoraggio e gestione di KPI e Key Risk Indicators (KRI) evoluti;
  • sviluppo di indicatori predittivi ed Early Warning Systems per il monitoraggio continuo dei rischi;
  • costruzione di modelli di scoring, classificazione e valutazione del rischio.
  • realizzazione di dashboard direzionali e strumenti di Business Intelligence a supporto delle decisioni manageriali;
  • sviluppo di modelli analitici avanzati basati su tecniche statistiche, Machine Learning e Predictive Analytics;
  • analisi delle relazioni tra rischi mediante approcci di Risk Network Analysis e Graph Analytics;
  • collaborazione con stakeholder business, Risk e Compliance per tradurre esigenze operative in modelli quantitativi e strumenti analitici;
  • sviluppo e manutenzione di data pipeline e processi automatizzati per l'elaborazione e l'analisi dei dati;

Per cominciare, cerchiamo un professionista senior che abbia le seguenti competenze tecniche e personali:

  • esperienza di 2/3 anni nella progettazione di dashboard executive, nello sviluppo di modelli predittivi, forecasting, anomaly detection e sistemi decisionali data-driven.
  • buone conoscenze lato BI & Data Visualization, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics e modelli probabilistici; ottima conoscenza di Python e SQL
  • capacità di tradurre esigenze di Risk e Compliance Management in modelli quantitativi e strumenti operativi fruibili dal business.
  • costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze con piattaforme SAS o ambienti di sviluppo analitico avanzati similari.
  • costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze con strumenti ETL quali IBM DataStage, Informatica o soluzioni equivalenti per la realizzazione di data pipeline automatizzate.
  • costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze maturate in contesti di Risk Management, Fraud Management, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) o AI Governance.

In EY potrai:

  • Accelerare le tue competenze: grazie a programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro e a strumenti AI che automatizzano attività ripetitive, potrai dedicare più tempo all'analisi, alla consulenza, all'innovazione e alla costruzione di relazioni professionali ad alto impatto.
  • Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: lavora in team internazionali e multidisciplinari, confrontandoti con prospettive diverse e contribuendo a sviluppare soluzioni che combinano tecnologia, competenze specialistiche e intuizione umana.
  • Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.

Avrai infine l’opportunità di:

  • accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
  • partecipare a programmi di leadership.

Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 33.000€ e 44.000€, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione. Per la specifica posizione è previsto un bonus al raggiungimento di obiettivi preventivamente comunicati e concordati.

In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico: le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.

Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in. Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.

Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.

EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world

In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo un Team di oltre 9.000 persone, distribuite in 20 città in tutta Italia. Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

Title: AI Scientist in Oncology
Description:
IFOM, the AIRC Institute of Molecular Oncology in Milan, is seeking a talented AI scientist to develop and apply machine learning and generative AI to one of the central questions in IFOM's long-term strategic plan and one of the hardest problems in oncology: discriminating cancers destined from the onset for indolent behaviour ("born to be good") from those with aggressive behaviour ("born to be bad"), including those featuring early metastasis and resistance or relapse after therapy.

Working within IFOM's institute-wide AI programme and in close collaboration with its experimental and clinical groups, you will use machine learning and generative AI to extract mechanistic insights, biomarkers and therapeutic vulnerabilities from data generated in experimental models and in large clinical cohorts of tumour-infiltrated tissue collected at diagnosis, integrated with clinical annotation of outcome, disease evolution, and response to immunotherapy and personalised treatment, turning IFOM's rich multi-scale data into predictive, mechanistic and clinically meaningful insight.

IFOM is uniquely positioned to tackle this challenging and rewarding question thanks to the convergence of multiple top-notch research activities across the institute's groups.




Role of the AI scientist in the IFOM community




Apply models that integrate single-cell and spatial omics, genomics, epigenomics, proteomics and multidimensional immunohistochemistry, together with radiomics and pathomics, pharmacogenomic screens in patient-derived xenografts and tumoroids, animal models, and functional genetic screens using CRISPR/Cas9 technologies, to model tumour fate from diagnosis onward.
Help decode tumour fate from an initial biopsy sample, uncovering determinants of indolent vs aggressive behaviour, including how epigenetic state, dormancy and reawakening, exposure to environmental agents, host immune fitness, and tumour biomechanical properties shape disease trajectory.
Contribute to translation by turning model outputs into predictive biomarkers of aggressiveness and relapse, and into actionable hypotheses for precision therapy.
Build shared foundation models, pipelines, benchmarks and infrastructure for rigorous, reproducible use across the institute, helping IFOM's research groups converge on this shared challenge.
Work closely with computational and experimental colleagues, and contribute to mentoring junior scientists and students.




Who we are looking for

Essential: PhD in computational biology, informatics, computer science or a related field; a strong record in AI/ML for biomedicine (computational oncology, single-cell/spatial biology, digital pathology, multi-omics or foundation models); proven ability to integrate multiple data modalities; hands-on expertise in modern deep learning and ideally foundation, multimodal or spatial AI; and a genuine interest in integrating clinical and experimental datasets to interrogate features of tumour aggressiveness, early metastasis and therapy resistance;




Desirable: experience building, fine-tuning or benchmarking foundation models for pathology, genomics, imaging or single-cell data; familiarity with translational and longitudinal clinical data; a record of high-impact publication; and experience collaborating across disciplines.




What IFOM offers

A central scientific role within a flagship AI programme in a Centre of Excellence for Research, with strong scope to shape methods and analyses.

Access to rich multi-scale data, including single-cell and spatial omics, genomics, epigenomics, 3D-chromatin, advanced imaging, multidimensional IHC, radiomics and pathomics, and functional-genomic screens, supported by an established Bioinformatics Unit and top-notch imaging, genomics and proteomics platforms.

Collaboration with internationally recognized molecular and cell biologists, pathologists and clinical partners belonging to IFOM's international network, converging on IFOM's long-term strategic mission.




How to apply

To apply, please submit the following documents in a single application to recruitment@ifom.eu:




Curriculum Vitae
Short Statement (covering research interests, motivation, and relevant experience)
Technical Research Plan
Contact Details of Three Referees




Please note:

Applicants who do not meet the minimum qualifications will not be considered.




For informal enquiries, you may contact Cecilia Osera, IFOM Scientific Officer, at cecilia.osera@ifom.eu.




Inclusive environment

IFOM is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace, and we particularly welcome applications from women and underrepresented minorities to contribute to scientific excellence. IFOM is a gender-equality institute, actively supporting equal opportunities and the advancement of women in science, fostering an inclusive environment where their careers can truly thrive.




This announcement is addressed to both sexes pursuant to Laws 903/77 and 125/91 and to people of all ages and nationalities pursuant to Legislative Decrees 215/03 and 216/03.

Title: Data Scientist / AI Engineer - MILANO
Description:
Fincantieri è uno dei principali complessi cantieristici al mondo, l’unico attivo in tutti i settori della navalmeccanica ad alta tecnologia. È leader nella realizzazione e trasformazione di unità da crociera, militari e offshore nei comparti oil & gas ed eolico, oltre che nella produzione di sistemi e componenti, nell’offerta di servizi post-vendita e nelle soluzioni di arredamento navale. Grazie alle capacità sviluppate nella gestione di progetti complessi il Gruppo vanta referenze di eccellenza nelle infrastrutture, ed è operatore di riferimento nel digitale e nella cybersecurity, nell’elettronica e sistemistica avanzata. Con oltre 230 anni di storia e più di 7.000 navi costruite, Fincantieri mantiene il proprio know-how e i centri direzionali in Italia, dove impiega 10.000 dipendenti e attiva circa 90.000 posti di lavoro, che raddoppiano su scala mondiale in virtù di una rete produttiva di 18 stabilimenti in tre continenti e oltre 21.000 lavoratori diretti.




Il gruppo Manpower in collaborazione con Fincantieri cerca un/una Data Scientist / AI Engineer.

La missione del ruolo è trasformare dati e processi in insight e soluzioni AI concretamente utilizzabili, combinando data science, machine learning, LLM e agenti per supportare decisioni, automazione e produttività.







Responsabilità principali

Analizzare dataset complessi e di grandi dimensioni, identificando pattern, KPI, anomalie e insight a supporto delle decisioni.
Sviluppare modelli statistici e di machine learning, dalla preparazione dei dati alla validazione dei risultati.
Progettare e prototipare soluzioni basate su LLM e Agentic AI, incluse architetture RAG, orchestrazione multi-agent, tool use e integrazione con fonti dati e servizi.
Analizzare processi e use case, trasformando bisogni di business in requisiti esecutivi, soluzioni implementabili e criteri di valore misurabili.
Realizzare automazioni e assistenti tramite Microsoft Power Automate e Copilot Studio, collaborando con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.
Comunicare analisi, risultati e raccomandazioni in modo chiaro anche a interlocutori non tecnici.




Competenze richieste

Python e SQL; solide basi di statistica, data analysis e machine learning.
Esperienza con LLM, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG e framework di orchestrazione agentica.
Conoscenza di Microsoft Power Automate e Copilot Studio; familiarità con API e integrazione di tool/servizi.
Capacità di lavorare su dati strutturati e non strutturati e di valutarne qualità, affidabilità e rilevanza.
Approccio problem-solving, autonomia, capacità di sintesi e forte orientamento al valore.
Ottime capacità comunicative e di interazione con stakeholder tecnici e business.




Profilo ideale

Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Data Science, Matematica, Statistica o discipline affini.
1-2 anni di esperienza in progetti Data Science / AI, preferibilmente con componenti GenAI o Agentic AI e contesti enterprise.




Elementi distintivi

Esperienza nella costruzione di PoC/MVP AI e nella misurazione del valore generato.
Conoscenza di data governance, sicurezza e principi di Responsible AI.
Esperienza in ambienti cloud/enterprise e collaborazione con team multidisciplinari

Title: Principal Research Scientist - Frontier Industrial AI
Description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Position: Principal Research Scientist - Frontier Industrial AI

Location: Cambridge/ London, UK, All EMEA, (hybrid)

Organization: AVEVA CT AI Research

Role type: Individual contributor

The role

AVEVA’s frontier AI research team, as part of the Chief Technologist Organization, focuses on developing the next generation of industrial intelligence. We are looking for exceptional researchers who combine original thinking with the ability to turn ambitious ideas into working systems.

You will define and pursue high-impact research questions, build experimental prototypes, publish influential work, and create defensible intellectual property. Research may span industrial foundation models for time-series and multimodal data, simulation and world models, trustworthy decision-support agents and staged autonomy, and AI-native approaches to industrial data foundations, ontology learning, and evaluation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in uncertain problem spaces, works with high autonomy, and finds practical ways to move difficult initiatives forward.

What You Will Do


Define and lead ambitious research initiatives in frontier industrial AI.
Develop new models, algorithms, evaluation methods, and system architectures.
Build high-quality experimental systems and validated research prototypes.
Publish at leading AI and machine learning venues and contribute to AVEVA’s patent and IP portfolio.
Create benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation frameworks for industrial AI.
Partner with leading AI labs, universities, and technology organizations
Take research from initial hypothesis through prototype and validation
Help shape AVEVA’s longer-term AI research direction and technical strategy.


What We Are Looking For


A PhD or equivalent research experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, or a related field.
Evidence of original research through strong publications, patents, open-source work, prototypes, or other meaningful technical contributions.
Strong hands-on ability in AI experimentation and software development.
Ability to independently identify important problems, formulate research hypotheses, and execute projects with limited structure.
Deep expertise in one or more areas such as foundation models, multimodal learning, time-series modeling, generative models, reinforcement learning, agentic systems, simulation, world models, representation learning, or AI evaluation.
Strong scientific judgment and the ability to design rigorous experiments and communicate results clearly.
High agency, intellectual curiosity, and a constructive problem-solving mindset.
Ability to collaborate across research, engineering, product, and teams.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with industrial, manufacturing, energy, infrastructure, engineering, or scientific data.
Recent publications at leading machine learning, AI, data mining, robotics, or systems venues.
Experience developing models at scale or building complex research systems.
Experience with simulation environments, digital twins, multimodal data, or industrial time series.
A track record of initiating and advancing research projects with limited supervision.
Exceptional recent PhD graduates with a strong research record are encouraged to apply.


UK Benefits include:

Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

About AVEVA

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

Title: Junior - Credit Risk Modelling| Milan

Junior – Credit Risk Modelling| Milan

The chance to build a better future is right in front of you

Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions. When you join the Financial Risk team in Milan , you are going to work on Credit Risk Modelling projects, for top-tier clients in the Financial Services sector.

Specifically, you will be tasked with:


developing models for the quantification of the main credit risk parameters (PD, LGD and EAD) for management and regulatory purposes, in line with Basel regulations;
assisting clients with stress test;
contributing to the inclusion of ESG topics in risk measurement;
measurement of financial instruments (fixed income, securitisation and derivatives);
implementing pricing models for complex financial instruments (e.g., CLN, ABS, securitisation and CMS);
restructuring of derivative portfolios and development of the related financial models.


Skills

Come As You Are - Your skills and characteristics

This is the perfect opportunity if you have:


a specialist degree (graduate or nearing completion) in business, statistics, engineering, mathematics or any other quantitative faculty;
knowledge of programming software and languages (Python, SAS, R, Matlab and Stata);
excellent knowledge of Italian and English, preferably with study and/or work experience abroad;
excellent problem-solving skills and an innate ability to take initiative;
good interpersonal and teamwork skills.


Your Future With Us - What you’ll find at KPMG


An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects, encourages and values diversity.
A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages creativity and teamwork.
Hybrid work arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance.
Advanced training and development programmes to stay current.
International mindset and innovative projects.
Initiatives focused on mental and physical well-being.


Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a gross annual salary of €30,000. In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.

Leadership, teamwork, respect every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity. These are the KPMG values that create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, so our professionals can achieve their full potential.

As a result of our commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, our Network complies with the standards of the ISO 30415 requirements, on the Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and UNI PdR 125, relating to gender equality” . Join us!

Title: Postdoc in Statistical Genetics Casale Group
Description:
Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 04.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious Postdoc in Statistical Genetics to shape our strategy for using human genetics as a causal anchor to understand disease mechanisms across biological scales.

Your mission

As Postdoc in Statistical Genetics, you will develop computational methods that connect human genetic variation to biological function. Using population-scale human genetics together with single-cell, spatial, and multimodal molecular data, you will identify the cells, cellular states, and biological programs through which genetic variation influences disease.

Your work will sit at the intersection of statistical genetics, machine learning, and mechanistic biology, with opportunities to lead methodological innovation and drive high-impact biological discoveries.

The role will give you access to population-scale human genetics, rich multimodal molecular and clinical datasets, and world-class AI and experimental research environments. This combination provides a unique foundation for ambitious research and enables biological questions to be explored at unprecedented scale.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:


Developing next-generation methods integrating human genetics and multimodal biology.
Driving biological discovery across population-scale, molecular, and clinical data.
Building an internationally recognized research profile through top publications and conferences.
Shaping the future of AI for science across academia, industry, and entrepreneurship.


Essential

What you'll bring


PhD in Statistical Genetics, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline, or expected to be completed within the next six months.
Strong publication record in leading computational biology, genetics, or biomedical journals. Ideally, your work has focused on developing computational methods motivated by biological questions using population-scale human genetics or multimodal molecular data.
Excellent programming skills in Python.
Strong foundation in statistical genetics and quantitative methods for analysing large-scale genetic and molecular data, with familiarity with modern machine learning approaches.


Preferred


Experience with GWAS, biobanks, or population-scale genetics.
Experience with single-cell, spatial transcriptomics, or functional genomics.
Experience developing research software for large-scale genomic or molecular datasets
Background in Bayesian statistics, causal inference, or probabilistic modelling.
Familiarity with modern AI architectures and foundation models.


Organizational and social skills


Strong analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
Ability to work independently while thriving in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment.
Excellent communication and scientific writing skills.
Creativity, intellectual humility, and enthusiasm for tackling challenging biological questions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to take ownership of ambitious research projects.


Why Human Technopole

HT offers an international and dynamic workplace, competitive welfare provisions, flexible working policies and relocation support. Researchers moving to Italy benefit from attractive tax benefits. We promote work–life balance and provide parental support initiatives.

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;
Motivation to build a career in the Risk sector with a focus on financial services industry;

Proficiency in modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Javascript or similar) and experience working with data processing frameworks;
Some knowledge with API development, cloud platforms, and containerization technologies;
Familiarity with data visualization tools and basic statistical modeling techniques;
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.

Analitic*, curios*, agile, orientat* alla qualità

Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata.

Title: Senior Climate Risk & Adaptation Specialist
Description:
Stiamo cercando una figura Senior da inserire nel team Climate & Adaptation di Deloitte Climate & Sustainability nella sede di Milano/ Roma, che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid.

Il team Climate & Adaptation di Deloitte Climate & Sustainability supporta aziende e istituzioni nel misurare e gestire i rischi climatici fisici e di transizione e nel definire e valutare i piani di adattamento. Lavoriamo su analisi di scenario, modellistica hazard-esposizione-vulnerabilità, stima del danno e valutazioni economico-finanziarie degli interventi di adattamento, traducendo dati complessi in decisioni operative. Operiamo in progetti data-driven con forte componente tecnica e di sviluppo di strumenti e modelli.

Your Role

La Risorsa Sarà Inserita In Un Team Multidisciplinare Con Un Ruolo Tecnico-specialistico Sulle Analisi Di Rischio Climatico Fisico e Adattamento, e Si Occuperà Di


Condurre analisi di rischio climatico fisico a livello di asset e di portafoglio, elaborando dataset climatici e geospaziali, stimando indicatori di hazard, esposizione e danno economico atteso, ed estendendo l'analisi al rischio di transizione
Sviluppare e calibrare curve di vulnerabilità asset-specific traducendo l'esposizione fisica in impatto economico concreto (danno diretto e indiretto, business interruption)
Identificare le misure di adattamento e i relativi business case (valutazione degli interventi, danno evitato, prioritizzazione delle azioni di resilienza), confrontandosi con gli ingegneri per il dimensionamento tecnico
Sviluppare workflow riproducibili in Python/R e tradurre i risultati in output e implicazioni di business per il cliente, con possibilità di guidare risorse più junior.


What We Offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa EUR 39.000 e EUR 46.000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Consultant.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements


Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Fisica, Scienze ambientali/climatiche, Data Science o STEM affini, e oltre 4-5 anni di esperienza in climate risk, modellistica del rischio fisico o adattamento (in caso di dottorato in ambito climatico, gli anni di esperienza saranno valutati caso per caso)
Ottima padronanza di Python e, preferibilmente, R, con familiarità con dati e strumenti geospaziali (netCDF/GRIB, raster, GIS) e workflow riproducibili
Competenza nella modellistica hazard-esposizione-vulnerabilità e nella stima del danno: curve di vulnerabilità, downscaling e bias correction, scenari climatici (IPCC, RCP/SSP)
Solida conoscenza della statistica per il rischio (distribuzioni, teoria dei valori estremi, simulazioni Monte Carlo)
Inglese fluente, autonomia nella conduzione delle analisi, attitudine al lavoro in team multidisciplinari e capacità di comunicare risultati complessi a stakeholder non tecnici


To Make An Impact That Matters

Deloitte opera in Italia dal 1923 ed è un punto di riferimento per imprese e istituzioni nei servizi professionali, coniugando l’expertise internazionale del network con una profonda conoscenza del contesto economico e normativo nazionale. Al 31 maggio 2025, Deloitte in Italia conta 15.000 professioniste e professionisti, un fatturato superiore a 1,7 miliardi di euro e una presenza capillare in 23 città sul territorio. Attraverso un’offerta multidisciplinare, supporta organizzazioni di diverse dimensioni e settori nell’affrontare trasformazioni complesse, dalla digitalizzazione alla sostenibilità, rispondendo alle crescenti esigenze di investitori, istituzioni e stakeholder. I servizi includono Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformation, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal.

In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo. Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che – in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti – hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Lavoriamo su analisi di scenario, modellistica hazard-esposizione-vulnerabilità, stima del danno e valutazioni economico-finanziarie degli interventi di adattamento, traducendo dati complessi in decisioni operative. Operiamo in progetti data-driven con forte componente tecnica e di sviluppo di strumenti e modelli.

Your Role

La Risorsa Sarà Inserita In Un Team Multidisciplinare Con Un Ruolo Tecnico-specialistico Sulle Analisi Di Rischio Climatico Fisico e Adattamento, e Si Occuperà Di

  • Condurre analisi di rischio climatico fisico a livello di asset e di portafoglio, elaborando dataset climatici e geospaziali, stimando indicatori di hazard, esposizione e danno economico atteso, ed estendendo l'analisi al rischio di transizione
  • Sviluppare e calibrare curve di vulnerabilità asset-specific traducendo l'esposizione fisica in impatto economico concreto (danno diretto e indiretto, business interruption)
  • Identificare le misure di adattamento e i relativi business case (valutazione degli interventi, danno evitato, prioritizzazione delle azioni di resilienza), confrontandosi con gli ingegneri per il dimensionamento tecnico
  • Sviluppare workflow riproducibili in Python/R e tradurre i risultati in output e implicazioni di business per il cliente, con possibilità di guidare risorse più junior.

What We Offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa EUR 39.000 e EUR 46.000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Consultant.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements

  • Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Fisica, Scienze ambientali/climatiche, Data Science o STEM affini, e oltre 4-5 anni di esperienza in climate risk, modellistica del rischio fisico o adattamento (in caso di dottorato in ambito climatico, gli anni di esperienza saranno valutati caso per caso)
  • Ottima padronanza di Python e, preferibilmente, R, con familiarità con dati e strumenti geospaziali (netCDF/GRIB, raster, GIS) e workflow riproducibili
  • Competenza nella modellistica hazard-esposizione-vulnerabilità e nella stima del danno: curve di vulnerabilità, downscaling e bias correction, scenari climatici (IPCC, RCP/SSP)
  • Solida conoscenza della statistica per il rischio (distribuzioni, teoria dei valori estremi, simulazioni Monte Carlo)
  • Inglese fluente, autonomia nella conduzione delle analisi, attitudine al lavoro in team multidisciplinari e capacità di comunicare risultati complessi a stakeholder non tecnici

To Make An Impact That Matters

Deloitte opera in Italia dal 1923 ed è un punto di riferimento per imprese e istituzioni nei servizi professionali, coniugando l’expertise internazionale del network con una profonda conoscenza del contesto economico e normativo nazionale. Al 31 maggio 2025, Deloitte in Italia conta 15.000 professioniste e professionisti, un fatturato superiore a 1,7 miliardi di euro e una presenza capillare in 23 città sul territorio. Attraverso un’offerta multidisciplinare, supporta organizzazioni di diverse dimensioni e settori nell’affrontare trasformazioni complesse, dalla digitalizzazione alla sostenibilità, rispondendo alle crescenti esigenze di investitori, istituzioni e stakeholder. I servizi includono Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformation, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal.

In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo. Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che – in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti – hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Accompagner les équipes métiers dans la définition d’objectifs réalistes à partir des besoins exprimés et des données disponibles.
Réaliser des analyses exploratoires, statistiques et visualisations de données.
Concevoir, entraîner et déployer des algorithmes et modèles de data science et d’IA.
Évaluer les performances des modèles et mettre en œuvre des actions d’amélioration continue.
Intégrer et déployer les modèles en production dans un cadre sécurisé.
Garantir la qualité des données utilisées pour l’entraînement, l’évaluation et l’exploitation des modèles.
Présenter clairement les résultats, limites et recommandations aux parties prenantes.
Contribuer à la gestion des risques liés aux modèles, aux données et à leur exploitation opérationnelle.

Expérience de 5 ans minimum en data science, machine learning, deep learning ou intelligence artificielle.
Très bonnes connaissances de Python, Jupyter, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Conda et Scikit-learn.
Très bonnes connaissances du traitement du langage naturel, du Machine Learning et du Deep Learning.
Très bonnes connaissances de la qualité des données et bonnes connaissances des technologies de gestion des bases de données.
Bonnes connaissances de l’approche ITIL.
Autonomie dans la réalisation et le déploiement d’algorithmes et modèles de data science et d’IA.
Formation supérieure en data science, intelligence artificielle, statistiques, informatique ou domaine connexe.
Français et anglais courants.
Capacité à travailler en équipe, à partager les connaissances, à prendre des décisions et à gérer les risques.
Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, de synthèse et de présentation.




Ce que nous offrons :

Une communauté internationale réunissant plus de 110 nationalités
Un environnement où la confiance est centrale : 70 % de nos leaders ont débuté au premier niveau de responsabilités
Un système de formation solide avec notre Academy interne et plus de 250 modules, incluant des certifications

Jours de congé supplémentaires selon l’ancienneté
Possibilité de télétravail selon la politique locale
Carte restaurant adaptée au marché suisse
Engagement fort en matière de durabilité et d’impact social via le programme WeCare Together

Title: Data Scientist (H/F/X)
Description:
Le Rôle

Pour un acteur du secteur public , nous recherchons un(e) Data Scientist à Genève pour concevoir, évaluer et déployer des modèles de data science et d’intelligence artificielle . La mission vise à transformer des données variées en analyses et modèles utiles aux besoins métiers.

Responsabilités


Collecter, intégrer, nettoyer et préparer les données ; automatiser leur extraction et leur mise à jour.
Réaliser des analyses exploratoires et statistiques, identifier les tendances et visualiser les résultats.
Concevoir et optimiser des modèles de Machine Learning , Deep Learning et de traitement du langage naturel (NLP) .
Évaluer la performance des modèles, ajuster les algorithmes et contrôler la qualité des données.
Intégrer et déployer les modèles dans les systèmes existants, en collaboration avec les équipes logicielles.
Présenter les résultats aux parties prenantes et conseiller les métiers sur des objectifs réalistes.


Ce Que Nous Recherchons


Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en data science et IA.
Très bonne maîtrise de Python , Jupyter , PyTorch , TensorFlow , Scikit-learn et Conda .
Solides compétences en Machine Learning , Deep Learning , NLP et qualité des données.
Bonnes connaissances des bases de données et des principes ITIL .
Master ou diplôme équivalent en data science ou domaine similaire.
Autonomie dans le développement et le déploiement des modèles ; esprit d’analyse, gestion des risques, prise de décision et capacité à travailler en équipe.
Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, de synthèse et de présentation ; aisance à challenger les besoins métiers et à proposer des solutions.


Petit plus


Expérience en Computer Vision , Reinforcement Learning ou autres approches avancées d’apprentissage automatique.

Title: Data Scientist Confirmé.e
Description:
Astrelya est un cabinet de conseil franco-suisse, en très forte croissance depuis sa création en 2017, spécialisé dans la transformation digitale, l’excellence opérationnelle et l’innovation technologique. Il est composé de 300 experts passionnés.

Le cabinet accompagne ses clients sur l’ensemble du cycle de transformation, depuis la phase de cadrage jusqu’à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle, avec une expertise forte en Data/IA, Cloud, DevOps et méthodes agiles.




Astrelya se distingue par un modèle fondé sur la proximité, la confiance et une culture humaine forte, qui place les collaborateurs au cœur de la création de valeur.




Votre Mission :

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités Data & Intelligence Artificielle, nous recherchons un.e Data Scientist Confirmé.e pour participer à la conception, au développement et à l'industrialisation de solutions innovantes basées sur la donnée et l'IA.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets Data Science, depuis la collecte et l'exploration des données jusqu'au déploiement de modèles en production.

Votre objectif : transformer les données en leviers de décision et développer des modèles d'intelligence artificielle performants, robustes et adaptés aux enjeux métiers.




Concrètement vous allez :

Collecter, préparer et fiabiliser les données issues de sources variées, en automatisant leur extraction, leur intégration et leur mise à jour.
Réaliser des analyses exploratoires afin d'identifier les tendances, corrélations et informations à forte valeur ajoutée.
Concevoir et développer des algorithmes de Machine Learning et de Deep Learning répondant aux problématiques métiers.
Explorer et mettre en œuvre des approches avancées d'IA : Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, selon les besoins des projets.
Évaluer, optimiser et améliorer les performances des modèles à l'aide de métriques adaptées, en veillant à leur précision et à leur capacité de généralisation.
Collaborer avec les équipes techniques pour assurer l'intégration, le déploiement et la sécurisation des modèles en production.
Accompagner les équipes métiers dans la définition de leurs besoins et la formulation d'objectifs réalistes au regard des données disponibles.
Présenter et vulgariser les résultats des analyses auprès des différentes parties prenantes afin de faciliter la prise de décision.
Être force de proposition dans l'identification de nouvelles opportunités d'exploitation des données et d'intelligence artificielle.




Votre futur environnement technique :

Langages & outils : Python, Jupyter Notebook, Conda
Machine Learning & Deep Learning : Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch
Intelligence Artificielle : NLP, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning
Data Science : Analyse statistique, exploration de données, modélisation prédictive, visualisation et qualité des données
Bases de données : Technologies de gestion et d'exploitation des bases de données
Méthodologies & bonnes pratiques : ITIL, architectures orientées services, intégration et déploiement de modèles d'IA




Qui êtes-vous ?

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Master en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou formation équivalente.
Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 années d'expérience en Data Science, avec une expertise confirmée en Machine Learning et Deep Learning.
Vous maîtrisez Python et les principales bibliothèques de Data Science (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
Vous disposez de solides compétences en traitement du langage naturel (NLP), en modélisation statistique et en qualité des données.
Vous êtes capable de concevoir, développer et déployer des modèles d'IA de manière autonome.
Vous comprenez les enjeux métiers et savez traduire des problématiques fonctionnelles en solutions Data concrètes.
Vous faites preuve d'un excellent esprit d'analyse, de synthèse et de communication.
Vous appréciez le travail collaboratif, le partage de connaissances et les environnements techniques stimulants.
Autonome, dynamique et adaptable, vous savez prendre des initiatives, challenger les besoins et anticiper les risques.




Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Un terrain de jeu pour progresser : Formations, certifications, coaching technique, communautés d’expertise (Java, Cloud, DevOps, Data…) et participation à des projets innovants (IA, architectures Cloud, automatisation…).

Un cadre de travail motivant : Projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée, événements internes réguliers, afterworks, ateliers tech et participation à des salons et conférences (DevOps REX, Devoxx, ParisJUG…).

Un engagement RSE : Médaille EcoVadis Gold, signature de la Charte de la diversité et du Pacte mondial des Nations Unies, ainsi que mise en place du mécénat de compétences.




Votre futur process de recrutement :

Entretien RH avec l'une de nos chargées de recrutement.

Le cabinet accompagne ses clients sur l’ensemble du cycle de transformation, depuis la phase de cadrage jusqu’à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle, avec une expertise forte en Data/IA, Cloud, DevOps et méthodes agiles.


Astrelya se distingue par un modèle fondé sur la proximité, la confiance et une culture humaine forte, qui place les collaborateurs au cœur de la création de valeur.


Votre Mission :

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités Data & Intelligence Artificielle, nous recherchons un.e Data Scientist Confirmé.e pour participer à la conception, au développement et à l'industrialisation de solutions innovantes basées sur la donnée et l'IA.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets Data Science, depuis la collecte et l'exploration des données jusqu'au déploiement de modèles en production.

Votre objectif : transformer les données en leviers de décision et développer des modèles d'intelligence artificielle performants, robustes et adaptés aux enjeux métiers.


Concrètement vous allez :

  • Collecter, préparer et fiabiliser les données issues de sources variées, en automatisant leur extraction, leur intégration et leur mise à jour.
  • Réaliser des analyses exploratoires afin d'identifier les tendances, corrélations et informations à forte valeur ajoutée.
  • Concevoir et développer des algorithmes de Machine Learning et de Deep Learning répondant aux problématiques métiers.
  • Explorer et mettre en œuvre des approches avancées d'IA : Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, selon les besoins des projets.
  • Évaluer, optimiser et améliorer les performances des modèles à l'aide de métriques adaptées, en veillant à leur précision et à leur capacité de généralisation.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes techniques pour assurer l'intégration, le déploiement et la sécurisation des modèles en production.
  • Accompagner les équipes métiers dans la définition de leurs besoins et la formulation d'objectifs réalistes au regard des données disponibles.
  • Présenter et vulgariser les résultats des analyses auprès des différentes parties prenantes afin de faciliter la prise de décision.
  • Être force de proposition dans l'identification de nouvelles opportunités d'exploitation des données et d'intelligence artificielle.


Votre futur environnement technique :

  • Langages & outils : Python, Jupyter Notebook, Conda
  • Machine Learning & Deep Learning : Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch
  • Intelligence Artificielle : NLP, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning
  • Data Science : Analyse statistique, exploration de données, modélisation prédictive, visualisation et qualité des données
  • Bases de données : Technologies de gestion et d'exploitation des bases de données
  • Méthodologies & bonnes pratiques : ITIL, architectures orientées services, intégration et déploiement de modèles d'IA


Qui êtes-vous ?

  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Master en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou formation équivalente.
  • Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 années d'expérience en Data Science, avec une expertise confirmée en Machine Learning et Deep Learning.
  • Vous maîtrisez Python et les principales bibliothèques de Data Science (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
  • Vous disposez de solides compétences en traitement du langage naturel (NLP), en modélisation statistique et en qualité des données.
  • Vous êtes capable de concevoir, développer et déployer des modèles d'IA de manière autonome.
  • Vous comprenez les enjeux métiers et savez traduire des problématiques fonctionnelles en solutions Data concrètes.
  • Vous faites preuve d'un excellent esprit d'analyse, de synthèse et de communication.
  • Vous appréciez le travail collaboratif, le partage de connaissances et les environnements techniques stimulants.
  • Autonome, dynamique et adaptable, vous savez prendre des initiatives, challenger les besoins et anticiper les risques.

Un terrain de jeu pour progresser : Formations, certifications, coaching technique, communautés d’expertise (Java, Cloud, DevOps, Data…) et participation à des projets innovants (IA, architectures Cloud, automatisation…).

Un cadre de travail motivant : Projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée, événements internes réguliers, afterworks, ateliers tech et participation à des salons et conférences (DevOps REX, Devoxx, ParisJUG…).

Title: Data Scientist - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will work in multi-disciplinary environments harnessing data to provide real-world impact for organizations globally. You will influence many of the recommendations our clients need to positively change their businesses and enhance performance.

You will be responsible for working on complex and extremely varied data sets from some of the world’s largest organizations to solve real-world problems. You will develop high-quality data science products and solutions for clients as well as assets for our internal data teams, focusing on modeling and working alongside the Data Engineering team. Additionally, you will present findings, recommendations, and provide consultation to stakeholders, both internal and clients.

Throughout your tenure, you will learn to work across various industries and sectors, gaining insights into diverse business challenges and applications of data science. You will build large-scale data and analytics solutions, handling complex problems and advanced client situations. You will also learn best practices in data and analytics development, including framework, responsibility model, high-quality code, data security, sustainability, and scalability. Working in collaborative teams with diverse skill sets, you will foster effective teamwork and learn from colleagues in a multicultural and creative environment. Staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in data science tools, techniques, and technologies, as well as participating in first-class learning programs, will be a key part of your development. You will also develop strong client-facing skills, including effective communication, problem-solving, and presentation abilities.

You will work with other data scientists, data/ML engineers, designers, project managers, and business subject matter experts on interdisciplinary projects across various industry sectors to enable business ambitions with data and analytics.

Our tech stack is diverse. While we advocate for using the right tools for the right task, we also take into account the client’s current landscape and preferences. Often, we use Python, PySpark, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Databricks, SQL, Docker, and Kubernetes. We also leverage our own proprietary tools such as Kedro, CausalNex, and MLRun. We work on a regular basis with cloud service providers such as AWS, GCP, and Azure.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Degree in (business) math, statistics, machine learning, data science, physics, computer science or engineering required
Master's degree or PhD level in the field of data science, computer science, business informatics or equivalent is a plus
Up to 2 years of professional hands-on experience in applying advanced data science methods and implementing technical data solutions (e.g. develop machine learning models), to solve business problems
A strong grasp of various analytics landscape, including business intelligence, machine learning, AI, and generative AI, and how to apply them effectively in different scenarios
Proficiency in Python, SQL (focus on data & analytics applications)
Professional experience in cloud-based analytical tools from market-leading providers such as AWS, MS Azure, Google Cloud
Practical experience in generative AI application development
Proven record of advisory works
Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities
Proficient communication skills in German and English
Effective communication and presentation skills, particularly the ability to explain complex analytical concepts in a comprehensible manner adapted to different groups of non-technical audiences e.g. business managers, heads of products, sales & marketing leads

Title: Data Scientist Senior
Description:
À propos d'Astek

Astek est un groupe international de conseil en technologies et en ingénierie, qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de transformation digitale, d'innovation et de performance opérationnelle.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités en Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Data Scientist Senior pour intervenir sur des projets à forte valeur ajoutée autour de la Data, du Machine Learning et de l'Intelligence Artificielle.




Votre mission

Vous interviendrez sur des projets de transformation Data & IA, avec pour objectif de concevoir des solutions innovantes, robustes et adaptées aux enjeux opérationnels de nos clients.

Au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, vous contribuerez notamment à :

Transformer des problématiques métiers en cas d'usage Data & IA concrets et créateurs de valeur.
Développer des solutions analytiques et prédictives en mobilisant les approches de Machine Learning et d'IA les plus pertinentes.
Participer à l'industrialisation des modèles, de leur conception jusqu'à leur intégration dans les environnements applicatifs.
Garantir la pertinence, la qualité et la fiabilité des solutions développées.
Favoriser l'adoption des solutions Data & IA en travaillant étroitement avec les équipes métiers et techniques.




Votre profil

De formation supérieure en informatique, Data Science, mathématiques appliquées ou équivalent (niveau Master), vous disposez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en Data Science, idéalement acquise sur des projets ayant abouti à une mise en production.

Vous combinez une solide expertise technique avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux métiers.

Vous maîtrisez notamment :

Python et les principaux outils de l'écosystème Data Science : Jupyter, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow.
Les approches de Machine Learning et Deep Learning, avec une expérience des problématiques de NLP.
Les bonnes pratiques de préparation, d'exploitation et de qualité des données.
Les enjeux d'intégration et de déploiement de solutions IA dans des environnements SI existants.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre autonomie, votre capacité d'analyse et votre esprit d'équipe. Vous savez prendre du recul, challenger les besoins et communiquer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme métiers.




Pourquoi rejoindre Astek Switzerland ?

Participer au développement d'une activité en pleine croissance en Suisse.
Intervenir sur des projets innovants autour de la Data et de l'Intelligence Artificielle.
Bénéficier de l'expertise et des communautés techniques d'un groupe international.
Évoluer dans un environnement qui valorise l'initiative, le partage de connaissances et le développement des compétences.




Intéressé(e) par ce challenge ?

Rejoignez Astek Switzerland et contribuez à transformer les données en solutions concrètes et créatrices de valeur.

Title: Data Scientist (80-100%)
Description:
Introduction

At Belimo, we believe that data has the potential to transform how buildings are commissioned, operated, and optimized. As part of our Research Digital Applications team, you will explore how data, machine learning, and cloud technologies can create measurable value for customers across the HVAC ecosystem.

We are looking for a Data Scientist who is equally passionate about both data and algorithms as well as their impact on real-world applications. Someone who enjoys diving deep into data and developing data-driven solutions but who is also curious about HVAC systems, building automation, customer challenges, and the business impact of technology.

Key Responsibilities


Develop data-driven solutions that address real customer challenges in HVAC applications.
Analyze large-scale operational, device, and application data to generate actionable insights.
Design, develop, and evaluate machine learning models and data analytics solutions.
Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and data products.
Collaborate with software engineers, HVAC application experts, and product teams to bring ideas from research into practical solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve commissioning, operation, diagnostics, maintenance, and energy efficiency through data.
Evaluate emerging technologies and methodologies in data science, machine learning, and cloud platforms.
Prototype, validate, and demonstrate new concepts that can create future customer value and business opportunities.


Required Expertise


Master's degree or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
Strong background in data science, machine learning, and statistical analysis.
Experience with data engineering concepts, data pipelines, and modern data platforms.
Proficiency in Python and common data science libraries and frameworks.
Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, familiarity with Azure, Databricks, Spark, or similar technologies is a strong advantage.
Understanding of MLOps, model deployment, and production data workflows is beneficial.
Ability to work independently and drive ideas from concept to prototype.
Fluent business English (written and spoken).


People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Title: Data Scientist Sensors
Description:
Every day, around 3,000 employees of RUAG and RUAG Real Estate make as significant contribution to the security of Switzerland. They ensure that the Swiss Armed Forces and other emergency and security organizations can comprehensibly carry out their tasks at all times.
 

Data Scientist Sensors
 

You can move it

Support the evolution of our modelling and analysis software ecosystem through collaborative development, documentation, and adherence to good engineering practices
Analyze real-world measurement and test data, derive performance metrics, and prepare technical documentation and reports for internal and customer use
Develop and apply machine learning techniques to extract meaningful patterns and insights from radar datasets
Assist in the investigation of technical incidents and data anomalies to ensure system reliability and smooth operations
Operate effectively within highly regulated, air-gapped environments, ensuring compliance with strict security and quality standards

 

What you should bring with you

Master's degree or PhD in Computational Science, Computer Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related discipline
Strong expertise in Python for scientific computing and data analysis, with solid experience in relevant libraries s.a. NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib
Expert in mathematical and numerical modeling of complex, dynamic systems, including handling noisy and high-dimensional data
Practical knowledge of machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Good familiarity with the Linux ecosystem and prior exposure to compiled languages (e.g. C, C++, Rust)
Demonstrated ability to rapidly acquire domain-specific knowledge autonomously and to translate scientific principles into practical engineering solutions
Able to strike a healthy balance between intellectual curiosity and focus on customer and company requirements
Excitement for a deep dive into the world of radar data processing
German: C1, English: C1, French: big plus
Swiss citizenship is required, and the candidate must be eligible for a Swiss security clearance

Do you not fully meet all the requirements? Apply anyway. We are always looking for talented and motivated people to join our team. We place great emphasis on diversity and equal opportunities and aim to build a versatile team where everyone can fully utilize their personal strengths. In particular, we encourage all people, regardless of gender, who may have concerns about accepting a position in a military-related environment to apply.
 

Your advantages

Salary and fringe benefits

We offer you a performance-oriented salary in line with the market, 13 months' wages as well as generous premiums and bonuses. Together with additional fringe benefits this makes for an attractive overall package.

Flexible work

It is very important to us that our employees find a healthy balance between their professional and private lives. This is why, among other things, we offer flexible working hours and options for working from home.

Benefits

At RUAG, you benefit from discounts on transportation and meals. You can also take advantage of attractive offers on our benefits portal and receive fleet discounts from a number of well-known car brands.

Career and development opportunities

We are committed to developing and realizing the potential of our employees. For this reason, we support them in continuously expanding their skills through training, courses and further education so they can achieve their professional goals.

Leisure activities

We care about our employees. That is why we give them a day off for their birthday, offer a wide range of sports activities and the opportunity to take additional days off with a pay deduction in addition to their annual vacation entitlement.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Scientist (Time Series Forecasting) based in Switzerland.

Join a data-driven team developing advanced forecasting solutions that power a live energy trading platform. In this role, you will build and optimize time series models to predict weather conditions, energy market prices, and electricity grid supply and demand. Your work will directly support data-informed trading decisions by transforming analytical models into reliable, production-ready code. You will collaborate in a fully remote, distributed environment where quantitative expertise, technical excellence, and practical problem-solving are highly valued. Time Series Forecasting: Design, develop, and refine forecasting models for weather conditions, energy market prices, and electricity grid supply and demand.

Data Analysis & Model Optimization: Analyze relevant datasets, identify patterns and trends, and improve forecasting accuracy to support reliable, data-driven trading decisions.
AI-Assisted Development: Incorporate agentic coding tools into daily development workflows to accelerate implementation, improve productivity, and support efficient software development.
Technical Integration: Work with data pipelines, analytical systems, and production environments to ensure forecasting solutions are reliable, maintainable, and suitable for operational use.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical findings, explain forecasting approaches, and collaborate effectively with distributed teams to align model development with business and platform requirements.


Requirements


Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or higher in Mathematics, Econometrics, Physics, Engineering, or another closely related quantitative discipline.
Professional Experience: At least three years of relevant professional experience in data science, quantitative analysis, forecasting, or a related field.
Time Series Forecasting Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing and applying time series forecasting models, with the ability to translate quantitative methods into practical solutions.
Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, model development, and production implementation. Experience with Go is considered an advantage.
Agentic Coding Tools: Regular, hands-on use of agentic coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, with the ability to integrate AI-assisted techniques effectively into software development.
Communication Skills: Excellent English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and collaborate with stakeholders in a remote, international environment.
Analytical & Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong quantitative reasoning, attention to detail, and a practical approach to addressing complex forecasting challenges and improving model performance.
Preferred Industry Knowledge: Experience working with energy markets, electricity trading, power grid data, or weather datasets is a plus.


Benefits


Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in a distributed team environment.
International Collaboration: Opportunity to contribute to a global energy trading platform and collaborate with professionals across different locations.
Meaningful Technical Impact: Develop forecasting solutions that support real-world energy market decisions and operational trading activities.
Advanced Data Science Challenges: Work on practical applications of time series forecasting involving weather, market prices, and electricity supply and demand.
Modern Development Practices: Use agentic coding tools and contemporary development workflows to improve productivity and streamline model implementation.
Professional Growth: Strengthen your expertise in quantitative modeling, production-grade data science, and applied forecasting in the energy sector.
