Title: Senior ML Data Scientist - Wireless People Sensing
Description:
Join Us in Building the Nervous System for Physical AI

Algorized is a VC-funded Silicon Valley deep-tech company with Swiss roots. We build edge-AI models that give robots real-time awareness of people using existing wireless sensors, enabling safer human-machine collaboration.

As we continue to scale, we are looking for a Senior Data Scientist who is passionate about innovation, applied research, and turning complex sensing challenges into robust products. If you thrive in a dynamic startup environment, take ownership, and enjoy working across data science, signal processing, and product development, we would love to meet you.

This is an on-site position based in Etoy, Switzerland. Fully remote arrangements are not available.

Responsibilities


Design, develop, and improve machine-learning models and algorithms for wireless people sensing using radar and other sensor signals
Play a key role in developing foundational models that can support multiple people-sensing tasks, environments, and sensor configurations
Develop signal-processing, machine-learning, and deep-learning methods that transform wireless sensor signals into accurate and robust people-sensing outputs
Design model architectures and learning approaches that capture spatial and temporal patterns in wireless sensor data
Design experiments, define evaluation methodologies, and analyze model behavior, limitations, and generalization
Evaluate and adapt relevant advances in time-series and representation learning to improve model accuracy, robustness, and generalization across environments and sensor configurations
Collaborate cross-functionally with software engineers and MLOps on infrastructure development
Mentor junior team members and contribute to the company's technical direction and data-science practices



Qualifications

Minimum Requirements


PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Wireless Communication, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field
At least 3 years of hands-on experience developing machine-learning or data-science solutions for real-world applications
Proven expertise in data science and machine learning, with experience applying statistical and learning-based methods to sensor or time-series data
Strong knowledge of signal-processing principles and practical experience applying methods such as spectral analysis, filtering, estimation, detection, tracking, or sensor fusion
Strong understanding of machine-learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, optimization, and generalization
Strong Python skills and practical experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, NumPy, and SciPy
Ability to take ownership of open-ended technical problems and move effectively from exploration to validated solutions
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with genuine enthusiasm for solving challenging people-sensing problems



Preferred Requirements


Experience with radar, RF sensing, LiDAR, computer vision, acoustics, or other sensing modalities
Experience designing experiments and working with complex, noisy, or imperfect real-world data
Familiarity with self-supervised learning, representation learning, multimodal models, or foundation-model development
Experience with 3D positioning, occupancy sensing, human activity recognition, tracking systems, or vital-sign estimation
Familiarity with edge-AI constraints and the trade-offs involved in moving models from research into production
Experience collaborating across data science, embedded, software, and product teams

Title: Data Scientist, Lab & Protein Data
Description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About The Role

You'll build out the data science layer of Adaptyv's foundry — the work that turns tens of thousands of raw, messy experimental readouts into clean, trustworthy, structured data that our customers, our models, and our own scientists can rely on. Binding (BLI/SPR), developability, biophysical, and functional assays all produce data at scale; your job is to make that data correct, comparable, and useful.

This sits at the intersection of three things: data quality (is this number real, or an artifact?), bioinformatics (linking experimental results back to sequence, structure, and protein design), and dataset building (turning foundry output into the kind of high-quality, benchmarkable data that frontier AI labs actually want). You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the lab scientists who run the assays, the software team who own the pipelines, and the customers who train models on what we produce. This is a hands-on build role, not a management one.

What You'll Do


Own the scientific logic of data quality across the foundry: define what "good data" looks like for each assay type — expected signal ranges, control thresholds, failure modes, edge cases — and turn it into automated checks.
Build anomaly detection and QC models that catch bad data the eye would miss: assay drift, instrument variability, plate effects, false passes and false fails — and distinguish real signal from noise statistically.
Work with the software and ML teams to specify, review, and improve the automated data pipelines that process instrument outputs, feeding back precise requirements for what to flag, auto-reject, or route to human review.
Connect experimental results back to the protein side — sequence, structure, and design — so wet-lab data and computational models reinforce each other.
Turn foundry output into structured, documented, benchmark-grade datasets that are a genuine asset for our customers and for training and evaluating protein-design models.
Apply real statistical rigor to multi-condition data at scale — thousands of samples across hundreds of simultaneous experiments — and make the results interpretable and comparable across runs.


What We're Looking For


Strong data science / bioinformatics background — you're fluent in Python (pandas, numpy, the scientific stack) and comfortable owning messy, real-world experimental data end to end.
Genuine biology grounding — you understand proteins, assays, and sequence/structure/function well enough to know what the data means, not just how to process it. You don't need to be a bench scientist, but you can't be biology-blind.
Statistical maturity — process control, anomaly detection, handling variability and batch effects; you can tell drift from noise and defend the call.
Prolific builder with the receipts to prove it. You've shipped a lot — pipelines, tools, models, datasets — and can point to concrete things you built end to end and put into real use, not prototypes that died in a notebook. You move fast, systematize what works, and have no patience for babysitting a fixed dashboard.
AI-native builder. It's 2026 — you build with coding agents like Claude Code as a default, and you have sharp judgment about what they produce.
Interdisciplinary by instinct. You're energized working across the lab bench, software, and ML, and you treat automation and data infrastructure as part of your job.
Bonus: experience with protein/sequence-structure data (bioinformatics tooling, structural data), ML on experimental data, or building datasets for model training and benchmarking.


Details


Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)
Type: Full time
Start date: ASAP


Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

Title: Staff Data Scientist - Wildfire
Description:
Role & Team

We are excited to add a Staff Data Scientist, Wildfire to our team. This individual will lead the scientific foundation of our Fuel Detection Model, the core engine that translates satellite and environmental data into an understanding of vegetation structure, fuel loads, and wildfire risk.

Working alongside ML engineers, and a product team, you'll define accuracy for our models, design the research and validation methods that prove it, and ensure our modeling choices are grounded in fire science and remote sensing fundamentals. This is a great opportunity for someone who is energized by open scientific questions with direct real-world stakes, and who wants their research to shape how utilities prevent catastrophic wildfires.

Time Zone Requirement: North America (NST, AST, EST, CST, MST, PST)

What You’ll Do


Lead research into how vegetation structure, fuel conditions, and wildfire risk can be estimated from satellite, LiDAR, and environmental data across diverse geographies
Design rigorous validation and evaluation methodologies, including ground-truth strategies, uncertainty quantification, and error analysis tied to real-world impact
Prototype and refine ML modeling approaches, then partner with ML engineers to translate them into production systems
Integrate established fire science, such as fuel models and fire behavior frameworks, with data-driven methods
Define scientific standards for experimentation, reproducibility, and model interpretability across the modeling organization
Communicate research findings clearly to engineers, product teams, customers, and the broader wildfire science community
Mentor ML engineers on scientific methodology and domain reasoning


Skills & Experience


8+ years of applied research or data science experience in wildfire science, fire ecology, forestry, remote sensing, atmospheric science, or a related quantitative field
Deep expertise in remote sensing and geospatial analysis, including working with satellite imagery and large-scale environmental datasets
Strong statistical modeling and machine learning skills in Python, with tools like GeoPandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or XGBoost
Track record of designing validation studies and evaluation frameworks for environmental or geospatial models
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex scientific work legible across technical and non-technical audience


Nice To Have


Familiarity with fire behavior or fuels modeling frameworks (e.g., Rothermel-based models, LANDFIRE fuel classifications)
Experience integrating physics-based models with ML, or with active learning and uncertainty quantification
Peer-reviewed publications in wildfire science, remote sensing, or environmental modeling
Familiarity with GCP, Vertex AI, or similar cloud-based platforms
Experience in remote-first or globally distributed team


Note: We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.

What We Offer


Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits
Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around
Home office stipend, co-working and ongoing education budgets
A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values
To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

Title: Expert·e en intelligence artificielle (IA)
Description:
Service de statistique (STAT)

Le STAT constitue le pôle cantonal en matière de science des données et d'intelligence artificielle. Ses principales missions consistent notamment à fournir aux autorités cantonales et communales ainsi qu'à la collectivité des informations statistiques pertinentes, significatives, fiables et cohérentes. Il collecte, produit, traite, analyse et stocke des données à but statistique sur la base de principes scientifiques choisis en toute indépendance, dans le respect de la charte de la statistique publique suisse.

Vos missions

En tant qu'expert·e IA, vous collaborez étroitement avec la déléguée cantonale à l'IA et êtes en charge de projets liés à l’intelligence artificielle et à la science des données. Dans ce cadre, vous réalisez des analyses avancées dans divers domaines (santé publique, finance, marché du travail, etc.). Vous développez et mettez en œuvre des solutions innovantes en matière de machine learning, deep learning et d'IA générative pour valoriser les données statistiques et soutenir la prise de décision. De plus, vous assurez la préparation et l’exploitation de grandes bases de données, tout en participant à la création et à la diffusion de formations relatives à l’IA au sein de l’administration cantonale et de ses partenaires. Dans l'exercice de vos missions, vous collaborez activement avec les services de l’État, les communes et le système statistique suisse. Title: Sr. Scientist - Computational & Applied AI
Description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations (gRED and pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS-CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

Within this newly established Center of Excellence, our activities operate across a distinct continuum of innovation and explainability. The Computational Biology and Medicine team stands as the vital final link in this continuum. Focussed on our delivery for the portfolio we bridge advanced algorithmic models with deep mechanistic validation to turn AI-driven hypotheses into validated therapeutic targets and deepen our understanding of disease biology and our patients.

The Opportunity

The Senior Computational and Applied AI Scientist within the Computational Biology and Medicine team is responsible for developing and deploying translational and applied AI frameworks to accelerate our Immunology and Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism (CVRM) portfolios. Operating at the final stage of translational execution for Discovery and Early Development, you will focus on moving beyond pure statistical correlation toward a systems-level, mechanistic understanding of disease and target biology. This position offers a trajectory of professional development aligned with scientific excellence and modern enterprise productivity frameworks ensuring our computational pipelines directly optimize R&D throughput and compress discovery cycles.


Working across departments to co-develop and implement advanced machine learning models focused on explainable and causal AI methods (such as causal models, symbolic regression, and counterfactual inference) to map disease pathways and unlock true mechanistic target validation
Adaptation and fine-tune state-of-the-art biological foundation models to predict novel therapeutic targets in complex immune diseases and CVRM
Bridging the translational gap by implementing adversarial domain adaptation and cross-species translation algorithms to dynamically align animal model phenotypes with human patient endotypes
Leveraging patient-level multi-omics, spatial profiles, and real-world clinical datasets to identify distinct disease endotypes, defining mechanistic patient selection criteria that enable clinical scientists to stratify responder vs. non-responder populations
Constructing dynamic representations and physics-informed models (e.g., Neural ODEs, PINNs) to capture physiological kinetics, temporal disease progression, and patient "digital twins" entirely in silico
Applying graph-based deep learning approaches, building and querying large-scale biological knowledge graphs to capture systems-level interactions across complex tissue-remodeling and auto-inflammatory networks
Anchoring the final stage of the organizational continuum, translating algorithmic innovations and "ML-ready" frameworks directly into high-value portfolio deliverables
Collaborating cross-functionally with clinical scientists, wet-lab disease biology experts, biostatisticians, and enterprise engineers across pRED and gRED to convert ambiguous therapeutic questions into concrete computational pipelines
Ensuring provenance and explainability is an integral feature of your insight delivery to stakeholders


Who you are


You hold a PhD (preferred) or MSc in Computational Biology, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Bioinformatics, Systems Biology, Artificial Intelligence, or a highly quantitative field
You bring 3+ years (Senior Scientist) or 6+ years (Principal Scientist) of post-doctoral or biopharmaceutical industry experience delivering applied AI and data science solutions in a drug-discovery setting
You possess hands-on experience applying causal inference toolkits, graph neural networks, or generative models to high-dimensional biomedical data (single-cell, spatial omics, or clinical trial datasets)
You possess experience adapting large-scale biological foundation models or building dynamic systems models to capture temporal disease progression
You demonstrate an active interest or deep domain understanding of human immunology, complex and multifactorial diseases, or system-level pathophysiology
You exhibit elite communication and teamwork skills, with a proven track record of acting as a cross-functional catalyst between pure computational engineers and wet-lab experimentalists


This position is based in Basel, Switzerland

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Title: Sr. Specialist, Decision Intelligence (m/f/d)
Description:
Job Description

Position Overview - Basic Functions & Responsibility

Digital is the multiplier that will allow Development Sciences and Clinical Supply (DSCS) to deliver better experiments faster, efficient filing and launch, more robust supply chains and higher-confidence decisions across the portfolio. The DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) organization is tasked with the mission to pioneer and deploy innovative digital technologies that drive the acquisition, automation and utilization of data to enhance insights, efficiency, and quality of DSCS processes and methods.

The DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) organization within our Research Team is accountable for driving the digital transformation, data architecture, and technology solutions that enable execution and operations within the DSCS organization.

The Senior Specialist, Decision Intelligence is a technical role responsible for developing advanced analytics and operations research capabilities to enable data-driven decision making and inform DSCS business operations. This role will focus on modeling, simulation and optimization frameworks to solve complex business problems.

The Senior Specialist, Decision Intelligence Will


Support the translation of business problems into mathematical models for business process simulation and optimization.
Buildrobust and sustainable analytics that can be seamlessly integrated with WebApps and/or Agents to streamline user interaction.
Develop and implement probabilistic forecasting and stochastic optimization techniques to enable strategic decision making given uncertainty.
Serve as a business analyst to support business cases for new digital capabilities. Define and track KPIs aligned with the value proposition for digital transformation within DSCS.
Contribute to designing, building, and implementing modern data foundations and pipelines.
Contribute to the development of custom web applications (WebApps) that allow business users to seamlessly interact with data products and model outputs.
Work strategically across the DSCS Digital Technologies team to streamline routine work through advanced automation and AI tools.
Contribute to the advancement of the DDT Decision Intelligence Strategic Roadmap, developing reusable components that support decision intelligence capabilities across business domains.


Primary Activities


Requirements Translation: Translate business processes and/or stakeholder requirements into accurate mathematical representations and technical specifications for corresponding models, agents and data products.
Decision Intelligence Strategy: Translate data and model outputs into clear, concise and interpretable business insights. Collaborate with Digital Operations Change Management and functional area SMEs to define and implement AI-enabled decision making processes across DSCS.
Business case development: In collaboration with DSCS SMEs, develop the business case and articulate the value proposition for new digital capabilities.
Performance monitoring: Define and track KPIs to monitor the value realized through digital transformation within the DSCS organization.
Modeling & Simulation: Develop mathematical models to simulate and/or optimize business processes using techniques including but not limited to machine learning, discrete event simulation and optimization.
Data Engineering: In collaboration with the Digital Operations Shared Services team, build and optimize scalable data pipelines leveraging Databricks, Python, Dataverse, and advanced SQL. Transform raw data into contextualized, AI-ready data products.
Agentic AI: In collaboration with Agentic Intelligence team, test and implement agentic AI workflows using tools like Copilot Studio to automate decision-making processes and generate proactive business insights.
Web Application Development: In collaboration with Digital Operations Shared Services team, develop and deploy user-friendly WebApps to support interaction with data and analytics.
Development & Code Management: Utilize modern development environments (VS Code) and AI coding assistants (Cline) alongside GitHub for robust version control of scripts, applications, and data models to ensure code quality.
Systems Architecture: Work closely with system architects to ensure scalable, secure, and efficient DevOps.
Documentation & Enablement: Document processes, code, mathematical models, data models, and system architectures; provide training and technical support to end-users as new digital capabilities are rolled out.


Required Skills And Qualifications


Experience: 3+ years in data science, operations research, data engineering or a related highly technical role.
Pharmaceutical development and/or clinical supply chain experience strongly preferred. Understanding of CMC development across modalities (ie small molecule, large molecule, vaccine) preferred.
Core Technical Stack: Strong expertise in Python. Experience building and deploying advanced machine learning models. Databricks and MLOps experience preferred.
Business Analysis: Proven track record of gathering complex requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translating them into actionable, technical roadmaps.
Agentic AI & Automation: Familiarity with or strong interest in Agentic AI and integrating AI agents into workflows.
DevOps & Developer Tools: Proven experience with GitHub for version control. Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development tools like Cline. Proficiency working in VScode or other equivalent integrated development environment. Experience deploying apps or agents preferred.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex business challenges and translate them into mathematical problem statements and corresponding technical solutions.
Collaboration & Influence: Demonstrated ability to develop strong, trust-based relationships to execute priorities with a diverse group of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Independence: Independent decision-making abilities with a proactive approach to delivering results.


Education And Skills


Education: Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of experience in Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, or comparable technical field

The successful candidate will be eligible for annual bonus and long-term incentive, if applicable.

Available benefits include medical, dental, vision healthcare and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, including 401(k), paid holidays, vacation, and compassionate and sick days. Konzeption und Umsetzung skalierbarer Datenarchitekturen und Datenmodelle für komplexe Anwendungsfälle

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in Data Science, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung; respektive Quereinsteiger/in mit vergleichbarer praktischer Erfahrung
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Umsetzung komplexer datengetriebener Lösungen

Title: SAP Business Intelligence & Data Analytics Specialist (m/f/d)
Description:
Your role in our team

As a Data Scientist (m/f/d), you will drive data-driven decision-making across our organization. You will design and develop new data products for our service business, with a particular focus on company-wide reporting. In the future, you will also support organizational development through the introduction and application of process mining tools for process analysis and optimization.

In addition, you will be responsible for further data-related development initiatives and provide valuable insights through your analyses to support strategic decision-making. Your work will strengthen a data-driven culture and enable data-powered services, giving you a direct impact on the success of the entire organization.



Design and develop data models based on SAP Datasphere
Create analytical dashboards and reports with defined KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and identify optimization opportunities based on the results
Implement, document, and roll out developed data models
Lead data-driven projects and initiatives as a Project Manager or Program Manager
Build and implement a Process Mining solution to enable root cause analyses



Your profile



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, or a related field
Strong passion for data, analytics, and business processes, combined with excellent conceptual thinking skills
Strong technical capabilities and the ability to solve complex business challenges in a structured manner
Good understanding of business contexts and the ability to identify opportunities where data analytics can improve processes and performance
Solid knowledge of data analysis methods and models
Confident working with large datasets and experienced in using databases and data visualization tools
Proficient to advanced knowledge of SQL and practical experience with SAP; knowledge of Python is an advantage
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly, persuasively, and in a stakeholder-oriented manner



Your Benefits



Thrive in an international, collaborative and fun work environment
Meaningful and challenging responsibilities that make a difference in a fast-growing industry
Diverse opportunities for further development
Competitive compensation package
Modern office, flexible working time and remote work option

Title: Data Scientist P&C Products, Processes, and Offering (all genders) befristet ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung bis Dezember 2027
Description:
Job-Beschreibung

80-100%, Winterthur / Smart Working

Gestalte deine Zukunft – gemeinsam mit uns!

Jede Erfolgsgeschichte beginnt mit dem Glauben an sich selbst. 

Als AXA sehen wir uns als Partnerin, die an deiner Seite steht und an dich glaubt. Deshalb fordern und fördern wir dich und zeigen dir proaktiv Möglichkeiten für deine Zukunft auf. Wir ermutigen dich und bieten dir Freiräume, damit du die Dinge, die dir wichtig sind, miteinander verbinden kannst. Gemeinsam mit deinem Engagement und deinem individuellen Beitrag wird daraus eine zukunftsweisende Partnerschaft. Für dich, für uns und für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden. Und das nicht nur für den Moment. Sondern auf lange Sicht. 

Bei der AXA erwartet dich eine Kultur, in der du deine Stärken voll entfalten kannst. Wir schätzen kritische Denkanstöße und innovative Beiträge, egal von welcher Hierarchiestufe sie kommen. Schreibe daher jetzt mit uns deine eigene Erfolgsgeschichte. Know You Can.

Im Bereich Data, Technology & Innovation arbeiten schweizweit rund 600 Software- und System-Entwickler:innen und entwickeln inhouse die Technologie von morgen. Dabei kollaborieren wir auch in globalen Teams und Netzwerken.

Wir prägen und integrieren neueste Tools, veranstalten Hackathons und unsere agilen Produktteams laufen selbstorganisiert und sind von A bis Z eigenverantwortlich.

Das erwartet dich


Du bist Teil des Product Teams "Genialytics" und bringst datengetriebene Erkenntnisse in die Weiterentwicklung unserer P&C-Prozesse und -Produkte im Bereich Angebotserstellung ein – mit dem Ziel, echte, messbare Effizienzgewinne zu erzielen
Du analysierst unsere Angebotsprozesse systematisch und datenbasiert – z.B. mittels Process Mining – identifizierst Schwachstellen, Engpässe und Optimierungspotenziale und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen
Du tauchst tief in unsere modellierten P&C-Produkte ein: Du verstehst die Logik und Regeln dahinter, hinterfragst sie kritisch und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit dem Business Möglichkeiten, wie diese Regeln vereinfacht, harmonisiert oder gezielt angepasst werden können – für schlankere Prozesse und eine bessere Kundenerfahrung
Du arbeitest eng mit Underwritern, Produktverantwortlichen, AI Engineers und Data Scientists zusammen und bist die Brücke zwischen Datenwelt und fachlichem Know-how – du machst aus Zahlen Geschichten, die das Business zum Handeln bewegen
Du bringst dein Wissen aktiv ins Team ein – durch fachlichen Austausch, das Teilen von Methoden und Best Practices und die gemeinsame Weiterentwicklung unserer analytischen Fähigkeiten


Das bringst du mit


Du bringst Erfahrung als Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren analytischen Rolle mit – und einen Leistungsausweis darin, aus Daten echten Mehrwert für das Business zu generieren.
Du hast Erfahrung mit Process Mining oder vergleichbaren Methoden zur datenbasierten Prozessanalyse – und weisst, wie du Ereignisdaten in handlungsrelevante Erkenntnisse verwandelst.
Python und der Data Science Stack (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn o.ä.) sind dein Alltag; du weisst, wie du Daten strukturierst, analysierst und visualisierst, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu machen.
Du kannst dich tief in Geschäftsprozesse und Produktlogiken eindenken – du verstehst nicht nur die Daten, sondern auch den fachlichen Kontext dahinter. Kenntnisse im P&C-Versicherungsgeschäft sind ein klares Plus.
Du bist neugierig, analytisch und hast den Mut, den Status quo zu hinterfragen – denn du weisst: Die wertvollsten Erkenntnisse entstehen oft dort, wo niemand bisher genau hingeschaut hat
Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und Englisch und verfügst über eine gültige Arbeitsbewillgiung für die Schweiz


Das bieten wir dir

Wir sind überzeugt: Zufriedene Mitarbeitende bringen die besten Leistungen. Deshalb investieren wir in Benefits, die spürbare Vorteile bieten – über das Übliche hinaus.

Flexibilität und Freiraum: Smart Working (flexibles Arbeitsmodell) Jahresarbeitszeit, 5 Wochen Ferien (ab 50 Jahren 6 Wochen), Feriengeschenk 2 Wochen alle 5 Jahre, Ferienkauf bis zu 10 zusätzliche Tage/pro Jahr

Job und Familie: Familienfreundliche Meetingzeiten, 22 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub, 8 Wochen Urlaub für den anderen Elternteil, Kinderkrippensubventionen, Betriebliche Familienzulagen, freie Tage für Betreuung von Angehörigen und in herausfordernden, persönlichen Situationen

Vorsorge und Versicherungen: Attraktive Pensionskasse mit weitreichenden überobligatorischen Leistungen inklusive Wahlsparoptionen, bis zu 30% Rabatt auf Versicherungsprodukte

Flexible Benefits: AXA Shareplan (Mitarbeiterbeteiligung), CHF 500 jährlich auf der Vorteilsplattform Swibeco, vergünstigte Mittagsverpflegung oder Lunch-Card, Smart Working-Pauschale CHF 200 pro Jahr

Mobilität: Rückvergütung fürs Halbtax, Reka-Pay bis CHF 1’000 pro Jahr (20% Rabatt), Flottenrabatt, kostenlose E-Ladestation, AXA Leihfahrräder

Gesunde Balance im Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Check-Ups, jährliche Gesundheitswochen, vielfältige Bewegungsangebote (online/offline), Massageangebote, Ruheräume, Employee Care, Online-Gesundheitsportal, diverse Seminare/Events rund um Gesundheitsprävention & Mental Health

Entwicklung: 3 Tage individuelle Lernzeit, kostenlose Coachings, grosses Angebot an Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, finanzielle Beteiligung an Weiterbildungen, Förderung der Internen Mobilität, Talent-Entwicklungsangebote, Seminare für Mitarbeitende 55+ (AXA Horizon), Engagement in Communities zu unterschiedlichen Themen, Teilnahme an Innovationsprojekten (Innoday, AXA Hackathon, UnConference), 2 Tage Zeit für Freiwilligeneinsätze (Umwelt & Soziales)

Title: Low Latency Quantitative Researcher, Asian Markets (FX, Equities, Commodities)
Description:
Company Description

Legacy Shift is focused on redefining the landscape of high-frequency trading across global markets. The firm combines a bold vision with a strong commitment to innovation, using cutting-edge technology to gain a competitive edge. By continuously pushing technical and quantitative boundaries, Legacy Shift seeks to unlock opportunities where others encounter limitations.
Team members are encouraged to experiment, iterate, and contribute to a culture of forward-thinking problem solving that directly impacts trading performance and market presence.




The Role

We are looking for an experienced Quantitative Researcher to develop systematic, high-frequency trading strategies across Asian financial markets.
You will research predictive signals from high-frequency market data, apply statistical and machine-learning techniques to identify persistent sources of alpha, and translate those signals into strategies that can operate successfully in a low-latency production environment.
This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of quantitative research, machine learning, market microstructure and algorithmic trading. You will work directly with traders and low-latency engineers, taking ownership of the research process from raw order-book data and hypothesis generation through backtesting, execution design and live deployment.
A strong understanding of Asian market structure is essential. You should understand not only how to build predictive models, but how exchange mechanics, liquidity, queue dynamics, transaction costs and latency determine whether a statistical edge can actually be monetised.




Responsibilities

Research, develop and improve systematic and high-frequency trading strategies across Asian equities, FX and/or commodities.
Develop predictive signals from tick-level, order-book and other high-frequency market data.
Apply machine-learning and statistical techniques to problems including short-term price prediction, liquidity forecasting, execution and market-state classification.
Analyse market microstructure across Asian venues, including order-book dynamics, queue behaviour, adverse selection, liquidity regimes and intraday patterns.
Build rigorous research and validation frameworks to distinguish genuine predictive signals from overfitting, data leakage and statistical artefacts.
Design realistic backtests incorporating transaction costs, latency, fills, queue position and other execution constraints.
Evaluate signal decay and determine the latency and execution requirements necessary to capture an identified edge.
Work closely with traders and execution researchers to translate predictive signals into executable algorithmic strategies.
Analyse market microstructure across Asian venues: order-book dynamics, adverse selection, liquidity regimes and intraday seasonality
Continuously research new datasets, modelling approaches and market behaviours that can generate additional trading edge.




Requirements

PhD or MSc in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Electrical/Computer Engineering or a quantitative discipline
3+ years of professional quantitative research or algorithmic trading experience within an HFT firm, proprietary trading firm, market maker or highly quantitative trading team.Excellent Python/C/C++ design and programming skills
Strong knowledge of Asian market microstructure across equities, FX and/or commodities
Practical experience applying machine-learning techniques to financial market data, with a clear understanding of overfitting, feature selection, non-stationarity and out-of-sample validation.
Understanding of the practical constraints of low-latency trading, including execution costs, latency, market impact, adverse selection and fill probability.




What We Offer

Direct access to full exchange order-book and tick data across all traded markets from day one
Rapid research-to-production pipeline — ideas can go live in weeks, not quarters
30 days holiday and gym membership
Full relocation package and visa sponsorship where required

Title: AI Scientist - LLM Systems
Description:
Artificialy is an AI company based in Switzerland, with offices in Lugano and Zurich. We design and deliver AI solutions that are impactful, transparent, and tailored to real-world industry needs.




Founded in 2020 by pioneers with over 40 years of combined experience in the field, our team brings together talented engineers, physicists, and mathematicians from across Europe. We are driven by curiosity, technical excellence, and a shared ambition to build AI systems that make a tangible difference.




We are looking for a AI Scientist, who will work with clients in the financial sector to design and develop LLM-based solutions from early experimentation through to evaluation and delivery. You will own solution design and evaluation methodology within a project team, across a varied project portfolio.




You must be willing to work onsite at least 80% of the time. Candidates must be based in Switzerland or willing to relocate to Switzerland.




About the Role

Your responsibilities will span the full lifecycle of LLM-based initiatives, from early experimentation and solution design through evaluation, delivery, and continuous improvement.
Projects may involve retrieval-augmented generation, agentic systems, fine-tuning, LLM-based evaluation frameworks (benchmarks, LLM-as-judge, error analysis), or other applied generative-AI solutions across a varied project portfolio.
You will own solution design and evaluation methodology within project teams, collaborating with software engineering, infrastructure, and domain experts to integrate solutions into enterprise ecosystems and present results to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.




Qualifications and Skills

Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent.
5+ years of working experience as AI Scientist or in a similar role or PhD
Strong programming skills (Python, SQL) and strong experience with ML libraries (Pytorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, etc.).
Hands-on experience building LLM-based systems (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, or similar).
Experience designing evaluations for ML/LLM systems (benchmarks, LLM-as-judge, error analysis).
Strong communication and presentation skills to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proficiency in English.




Nice to Have

Experience in finance or other regulated industries.
Journal publications
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred).




We offer

Full-time permanent contract
Competitive compensation and growth opportunities
A stimulating scientific environment with an informal working atmosphere
Mentorship and continuous learning

Die FINMA beaufsichtigt den Schweizer Finanzmarkt. Die Digitalisierung spielt dabei eine zentrale Rolle. Dafür engagieren sich täglich über 800 kompetente und motivierte Mitarbeitende in acht verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen.

Wir bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, im Rahmen einer 3-jährigen Anstellung on-the-job Berufserfahrung zu sammeln. Durch den jährlichen Wechsel des Fachgebiets innerhalb der FINMA gewinnen Sie vertiefte Einblicke in unterschiedliche Geschäftsbereiche der Finanzmarktaufsicht und erweitern Ihr Fachwissen kontinuierlich in den Bereichen Asset Management und Märkte, Integrierte Risikoexpertise, Operations und Versicherungen.
 
Für den Start per 1. April 2027 suchen wir vier motivierte Personen.
 

Traineeprogramm Digital & Analytics (m/w/d) / 100% / Bern oder Zürich - per 01.04.2027
 


Hauptaufgaben

Extraktion, Analyse, Aufbereitung und Visualisierung FINMA-spezifischer Daten sowie Erstellung entsprechender Berichte
Weiterentwicklung von Digitalisierungs- und Analyseinstrumenten
Mitarbeit im Data Innovation Lab, insbesondere bei der Anwendung von ML-Methoden
Mitwirkung an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten rund um Daten, Digitalisierung und Analytics
Einblicke in unterschiedliche Fachbereiche der FINMA und aktive Mitarbeit an wechselnden daten- und technologiebezogenen Fragestellungen

 

Profil

Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Data Science, Mathematik, Informatik, Statistik oder einer vergleichbaren Studienrichtung
Gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python oder R sowie Erfahrung mit Datenbanken, SQL, Reporting-Tools und der Analyse von Daten
Hohe Methodenkompetenz, vernetztes Denken und Eigeninitiative sowie eine selbstständige, zuverlässige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (B2); gute Französischkenntnisse (B2) sind von Vorteil

Title: Graduate Quant Researcher - Digital Assets
Description:
As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you will work with experienced researchers and developers in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. You will learn how trading ideas are researched, tested, and deployed, while contributing to live strategy development from early in your career.

Your Core Responsibilities


Research and test data-driven trading ideas
Analyse large and complex datasets from cryptocurrency exchanges, DeFi protocols, and financial markets
Build, test, and improve models, signals, and algorithms that support trading strategies
Work with IMC’s cutting-edge data, software, and high-performance computing infrastructure
Collaborate closely with researchers, developers, and engineers to turn research into production-ready strategies
Learn how to evaluate trading opportunities with a focus on performance, scalability, robustness, and risk


Your Skills And Experience


Final-year student or recent graduate in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn quickly
Programming experience, ideally in Python. Familiarity with C++ is a plus
A genuine interest in financial markets, trading, crypto, or DeFi
Comfortable working with data and applying quantitative methods to real-world problems
Curious, collaborative, and eager to take ownership in a fast-moving environment


Prior experience in trading, crypto, or financial markets is helpful but not required.

This is an on-site role based in Zug, Switzerland, with very limited flexibility for working from home.

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent
5+ years of working experience as AI Scientist or in a similar role or PhD
Hands-on experience building LLM-based systems (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, or similar)
Strong programming skills (Python, SQL) and experience with ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, etc.)

Strong communication and presentation skills to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Proficiency in English


Nice to Have


Experience in finance or other regulated industries
Journal publications
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)


We offer


Full-time permanent contract
Competitive compensation and growth opportunities
A stimulating scientific environment with an informal working atmosphere
Mentorship and continuous learning

Title: Scientist in Computational Neuromodulation
Description:
The Wyss Center is seeking a Scientist in Computational Neuromodulation to develop the imaging, modeling and targeting methods that underpin non-invasive neuromodulation therapies. The position is part of a collaboration with Prisma Neurotech, a young startup in the neurotech domain, with the goal of adapting brain circuit targeting methods developed for deep brain stimulation (DBS) to non-invasive neuromodulation. The main focus is low-intensity transcranial focused ultrasound (LIFUS), but the methods also extend to other non-invasive techniques such as TMS, tDCS, tACS and tES. One concrete goal of the collaboration is to develop the resulting targeting and planning software into a medical device product (software as a medical device). The position reports to the Head of AI and Therapeutic Neurotechnologies from Wyss Center.




In their position, the Scientist in Computational Neuromodulation has a broad set of responsibilities, including:




Gap Analysis and Development Strategy: Perform a gap analysis of the technical, scientific, clinical, software, data, quality-management and implementation requirements for extending the existing technology to non-invasive neuromodulation, including the review of existing assets, workflows, technical capabilities, clinical needs, data and user requirements, software dependencies and limitations of the current approach. On this basis, contribute to the joint development strategy: the selection of the initial neuromodulation modality, the definition of the prototype functionality, and the technical and clinical milestones.
Image-Guided Targeting and Treatment Planning: Build and maintain per-subject pipelines that go from MRI and CT data to a treatment plan. This includes segmentation of skull, scalp and brain tissue, registration to standard spaces and atlases, co-registration of the transducer or coil position, estimation of the acoustic or electric field at the target, and derivation of dose and safety metrics. Produce outputs that can be used directly for neuronavigation and session planning, and document their accuracy and limitations.
Individualized Neuromodulation Targets: Develop and validate methods that define subject-specific targets. Combine structural and functional imaging, tractography and functional connectivity, normative connectomes and atlases, electrophysiology and clinical response data to estimate where stimulation is most likely to produce the intended effect, drawing on established DBS targeting approaches such as those in Lead-DBS where they transfer to non-invasive use. Quantify the uncertainty of each target, test the methods against outcome data where available, and make the reasoning behind each target traceable.
Simulation and Modeling: Set up, run and validate acoustic and thermal simulations of transcranial ultrasound (for example with BabelBrain, k-Wave, or Sim4Life), and electric field simulations for TMS and tES (for example with SimNIBS). Compare simulation results with phantom measurements, published benchmarks and in vivo data where possible, and keep a record of model assumptions and validation results.
Software Development and Medical Device Readiness: Turn the models and targeting methods into a prototype application together with the Prisma Neurotech team and review it with clinical and scientific users. Put this software on track for development into a medical device within the Wyss Center's ISO 13485 certified quality management system (IEC 62304, ISO 14971). Deploy pipelines on the Center's AI Ready Brain Data (AIR.BD) infrastructure so that results can be reproduced.
Support of Experimental and Clinical Studies: Contribute to the design of neuromodulation studies with clinical and academic partners, provide targeting and planning outputs for stimulation sessions, and help interpret the resulting imaging, physiological and behavioural data. Feed what is learned in the studies back into the models and targeting methods.
Team Interaction and Collaborative Working: Work as an integrated member of the AI Innovation and Therapeutic Neurotechnology team. Represent the modeling work in joint project meetings with Prisma Neurotech and prepare material for milestone reviews with the Wyss Center leadership.
Scientific Dissemination: Publish results in peer-reviewed journals, present them at scientific conferences, and contribute to grant and project proposals.




Expected profile

A PhD in biomedical engineering, physics, neuroscience, computer science or a comparable quantitative discipline.
Knowledge of the computational aspects (for example modeling, imaging, targeting) of focused ultrasound, or of other non-invasive neuromodulation techniques, including practical experience with MRI and CT data (segmentation, registration, atlas-based analysis). Experience with connectomics or electrophysiological data is an advantage.
Proficient in programming, with working habits that include version control with git, automated testing and containerised environments. Experience with tools such as BabelBrain, k-Wave, SimNIBS or Lead-DBS is an advantage.
A track record of delivered, documented and reproducible work, such as peer-reviewed publications or released software, experience in evaluating existing software or clinical workflows and turning the findings into requirements, and the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary team of clinicians, engineers and researchers.
Experience with software development in a regulated environment (for example medical device software under IEC 62304, design controls, verification and validation, risk management) is an advantage.
Fluency in oral and written English is a must, French is a plus.




Starting date: As soon as possible

Job Description

Position Overview - Basic Functions & Responsibility

Digital is the multiplier that will allow Development Sciences and Clinical Supply (DSCS) to deliver better experiments faster, efficient filing and launch, more robust supply chains and higher-confidence decisions across the portfolio. The DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) organization is tasked with the mission to pioneer and deploy innovative digital technologies that drive the acquisition, automation and utilization of data to enhance insights, efficiency, and quality of DSCS processes and methods.

The DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) organization within the Research team is accountable for driving the digital transformation, data architecture, and technology solutions that enable execution and operations within the DSCS organization.

The Associate Director, Decision Intelligence is a technical role responsible for developing advanced analytics and operations research capabilities to enable data-driven decision making and inform DSCS business operations. This role will focus on modeling, simulation and optimization frameworks to solve complex business problems.

The Associate Director, Decision Intelligence Will


Translate business problems into mathematical models/frameworks for business process simulation and optimization.
Design robust and sustainable analytics that can be seamlessly integrated with WebApps and/or Agents to streamline user interaction.
Develop and implement probabilistic forecasting and stochastic optimization techniques to enable strategic decision making given uncertainty.
Serve as a business analyst to develop business cases for new digital capabilities. Define and track KPIs aligned with the value proposition for digital transformation within DSCS.
Contribute to designing, building, and implementing modern data foundations and pipelines.
Contribute to the development of custom web applications (WebApps) that allow business users to seamlessly interact with data products and model outputs.
Work strategically with Change Management and DSCS functional area SMEs to design and implement AI-enabled business processes.
Contribute to the advancement of the DDT Decision Intelligence Strategic Roadmap, developing reusable methods and components that support decision intelligence capabilities across business domains.


Primary Activities


Requirements Translation: Translate business processes and/or stakeholder requirements into accurate mathematical representations and technical specifications for corresponding models, agents and data products.

Performance monitoring: Define and track KPIs to monitor the value realized through digital transformation within the DSCS organization.

Data Engineering: In collaboration with the Digital Operations Shared Services team, design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines leveraging Databricks, Python, Dataverse, and advanced SQL. Transform raw data into contextualized, AI-ready data products.
Agentic AI: In collaboration with Agentic Intelligence team, design, test, and implement agentic AI workflows using tools like Copilot Studio to automate decision-making processes and generate proactive business insights.
Web Application Development: In collaboration with Digital Operations Shared Services team, develop and deploy user-friendly WebApps to support interaction with data and analytics.
Development & Code Management: Utilize modern development environments (VS Code) and AI coding assistants (Cline) alongside GitHub for robust version control of scripts, applications, and data models to ensure code quality.
Systems Architecture: Work closely with system architects to ensure scalable, secure, and efficient DevOps.
Documentation & Enablement: Document processes, code, mathematical models, data models, and system architectures; provide training and technical support to end-users as new digital capabilities are rolled out.


Required Skills And Qualifications


Experience: 5+ years in data science, operations research, data engineering or a related highly technical role.
Pharmaceutical development and/or clinical supply chain experience. Understanding of CMC development across modalities (ie small molecule, large molecule, vaccine) strongly preferred.
Core Technical Stack: Strong expertise in Python. Experience building and deploying advanced machine learning models. Databricks and MLOps experience preferred.
Business Analysis: Proven track record of gathering complex requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translating them into actionable, technical roadmaps.

Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex business challenges and translate them into mathematical problem statements and corresponding technical solutions.
Collaboration & Influence: Demonstrated ability to develop strong, trust-based relationships to drive change and execute priorities with a diverse group of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including senior executives.
Independence: Independent decision-making abilities with a proactive approach to leading projects and delivering results.

Education: PhD with 1+ year of experience or Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of experience in Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, or comparable technical field.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will transform complex gaming and player data into actionable insights that drive product performance, user engagement, and business growth. You will work at the intersection of data analytics, statistics, and data science, helping teams understand player behavior and uncover opportunities for product improvement. Through advanced analytical techniques, experimentation, and predictive modeling, you will identify key performance drivers and support data-informed decisions. You will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product Managers in a highly technical, data-driven environment. Your work will contribute to improving gaming experiences, validating product hypotheses, and developing innovative analytical solutions. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a product-oriented mindset and a passion for turning data into measurable business impact.

Analyze large volumes of game and player data to identify patterns, trends, behavioral dynamics, and opportunities for business growth.
Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations for product improvements, helping stakeholders understand what works, what does not, and where to focus next.
Conduct in-depth investigations into performance anomalies, game features, and changes in player behavior to determine underlying causes and explain their business implications.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product Managers to develop hypotheses, validate assumptions, and contribute to hands-on data science and machine learning tasks.
Apply statistical analysis and causal inference techniques to identify the factors influencing user behavior and product performance.
Support predictive model development and validation through feature engineering, dataset preparation, model evaluation, and A/B testing.
Design and implement experiments, evaluate their results, and provide statistically sound recommendations to support product decisions.
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance monitoring tools that help stakeholders track key performance indicators and make informed decisions.
Define and refine metrics for new products and features, translating high-level business requirements into measurable analytical frameworks.
Communicate complex analytical results clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Leverage AI coding assistants and other AI-powered tools to automate repetitive tasks, improve analytical workflows, and enhance the quality and efficiency of deliverables.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative discipline.
At least 5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or Data Scientist, preferably within the gaming, iGaming, or technology industry.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to uncover meaningful insights and translate data into clear business recommendations.
Experience working with large-scale datasets and distributed data processing technologies such as BigQuery, Spark, Hive, or equivalent tools.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, data transformation, and data wrangling.
Strong Python skills and practical experience with data science libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn.
Proficiency in data visualization and dashboard development using tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Solid knowledge of experimental design, statistical testing, A/B testing, hypothesis testing, and confidence intervals.
Working knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised learning, feature engineering, model training and validation, and evaluation metrics.
Familiarity with causal inference and uplift modeling, along with practical experience contributing to machine learning workflows or model development in collaboration with Data Scientists.
Experience using AI coding assistants or other AI tools in daily work to improve automation, productivity, and output quality.
English proficiency at B2 level or above.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to diverse audiences.
A proactive, product-oriented mindset and the ability to move beyond reporting metrics to recommend solutions that deliver measurable impact.

A strong product mindset, with an emphasis on identifying opportunities and proposing practical, impact-driven solutions.

Title: Quantitative Modelling Specialist (Life & Health)
Description:
We are looking for an experienced quantitative modelling specialist to develop and enhance SCOR's Internal Capital Model for Life & Health (L&H) risks. The role combines quantitative risk modelling with production-quality Python development and offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of insurance, data and software engineering.

As a leading global reinsurer, SCOR offers its clients a diversified and innovative range of reinsurance and insurance solutions and services to control and manage risk. Applying "The Art & Science of Risk," SCOR uses its industry-recognized expertise and cutting-edge financial solutions to serve its clients and contribute to the welfare and resilience of society in around 160 countries worldwide.

Working at SCOR means engaging with some of the best minds in the industry - actuaries, data scientists, underwriters, risk modelers, engineers, and many others - as we work together to find solutions to pressing challenges facing societies.

As an international company, our common culture is defined by "The SCOR Way." Serving both to build momentum that drives the Group forward and as a compass to guide our actions and choices, The SCOR Way is anchored by five core values, reflecting the input of employees at all levels of the Group. We care about clients, people, and societies. We perform with integrity. We act with courage. We encourage open minds. And we thrive through collaboration.

SCOR supports inclusion and the diversity of talents, and all positions are open to people with disabilities.

The successful candidate will bring strong quantitative and programming capabilities, sound software-engineering judgement and either existing knowledge of L&H insurance risks or a demonstrated ability to quickly develop expertise in new and complex domains.

Key responsibilities:

Methodology: Enhance and maintain SCOR's Internal Model methodology with a focus on L&H risks and dependencies with other risks.
Software engineering & implementation: Design, develop and maintain robust, reliable and computationally efficient Python implementations of Internal Model methodologies, helping shape the architecture of the L&H modelling framework and applying sound software-engineering principles to ensure code quality, maintainability, scalability and performance.
Model changes & governance: Perform model change impact assessments, contribute to methodological enhancements, maintain technical documentation and support cross-functional model development initiatives.
Results analysis & communication: Analyse, visualise and communicate model results to internal stakeholders, with a particular focus on the drivers of L&H capital requirements.
Collaboration: Collaborate with colleagues across Risk Management, Finance, L&H Business Units and Data/AI in Paris, Dublin, Zurich and Cologne.

Your profile:

Several years of relevant professional experience in risk modelling, actuarial modelling, quantitative modelling or a related quantitative discipline.
Strong Python programming skills and experience developing and maintaining large object-oriented applications, with a good understanding of software architecture, code quality and maintainability.
Ability to translate quantitative methodologies into robust, efficient and maintainable software solutions and to improve the performance and scalability of modelling applications.
Knowledge of Solvency II, the Swiss Solvency Test, IFRS17 or L&H insurance risks is an advantage.
Solid quantitative background in mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, engineering, computer science or a related discipline.
Analytical mindset, proactive attitude and strong communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in an international, multidisciplinary environment.

Overview

Job description

A PhD student position in spatio-temporal modelling of extreme wildfires events funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) is available in Dr. Marj Tonini's lab at the Institute of Earth Surface Dynamics (IDYST), Faculty of Geosciences and Environment (GSE), University of Lausanne (Unil), in collaboration with Prof. Valérie Chavez-Demoulin (co-PI), Professor of Statistics at the Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne), Unil. The lab focuses on developing innovative machine learning and statistical approaches for complex spatiotemporal environmental datasets. We are looking for a candidate to join ExtFire, an SNSF-funded project that aims to develop the first pan-European framework combining non-stationary extreme value theory (EVT), causal inference, and tail-sensitive deep learning to quantify and predict extreme wildfire risk in a reproducible and transferable way. In addition to the two PIs, the ExtFire team brings together three external partners with complementary expertise : Prof. Marco Turco (University of Murcia, Spain) contributes specialized expertise in fire-climate interactions; Dr. Paolo Fiorucci (CIMA Research Foundation, Italy) brings expertise in fire-spread simulation; and Dr. Erwan Koch (Expertise Centre for Climate Extremes, Unil) provides expertise in spatial EVT and max-stable random fields. The successful candidate will join Dr. Tonini's lab at IDYST and work closely with the postdoctoral researcher recruited within the ExtFire project, benefiting from the expretise and support of the entire ExtFire team.

Your Responsibilities

The successful candidate will develop research leading to a PhD in environmental sciences under the main supervision of Dr. Marj Tonini. The PhD student will contribute to ExtFire by developing the data-driven core of the project.

The Main Tasks Include


harmonising and integrating large open datasets on wildfires, meteorology and land surface into a consistent pan-European data infrastructure;
develping statistical and spatio-temporal models to characterise extreme fire events, such as those with very large burned areas or rapid spread;
building the datasets and baseline machine learning models used to evaluate predictions of extreme events;
applying explainable AI methods (e.g. SHAP) to identify the main environmental drivers of extreme fires across regions;
writing scientific papers, presenting results at international conferences and assisting in teaching (up to 10% of the time).


Your Qualifications

We are looking for a motivated candidate with the following profile :


Desire to write a thesis in spatio-temporal modelling of extreme events (wildfires);
Master's degree in environmental sciences, geosciences, statistics, applied mathematics, physics, computer science, or a closely related quantitative field, with a strong academic record;
Hands-on experience with machine learning, ideally deep learning (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow), and familiarity with explainable AI;
Solid background in statistics and data analysis (e.g. probability, regression, time series or spatial statistics). Knowledge of extreme value theory is an asset;
Solid programming skills in Python and/or R, demonstrated by experience in processing and analysing large datasets (e.g. gridded climate or remote sensing data, NetCDF/raster formats);
Fluency in English, written and spoken, with the ability to write scientific reports. Knowledge of French is an asset;
Proven experience in the quantitative analysis or modelling of natural hazards (e.g. wildfires, floods, landslides, earthquakes), as shown by a thesis, project or publication, is an asset.


How to apply

Please submit the following documents in a single PDF file :


Motivation letter (max. 1 page) outlining your motivation and explaining how your backround and experience align with the project.
Curriculum vitae, including a list of publications, if any.
Copies of academic qualifications, transcripts of grades and Master's thesis.
Names, e-mail addresses and phone numbers of two referees.
Short statement (max. 1 page) describing a previous project involving the quantitative or computational analysis of environmental or natural hazard data (e.g. your Master's thesis, a research project, or an internship), including your personal contribution and a link to your code (e.g. GitHub), if available.


Please note: Only applications submitted through the official UNIL Career Opportunities website will be considered.

Title: Lead Portfolio and Performance Analytics
Description:
Are you looking for your next opportunity?

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a Lead, Portfolio and Performance Analytics in our newly established CUO Office team for Continental Europe.

Reporting directly to the Chief Underwriting Officer (CUO) for Continental Europe, this role offers a unique opportunity to lay the groundwork for a central function that supports portfolio monitoring and sustainable profitability across Sompo’s commercial insurance operations in Continental Europe. As a foundational member of the CUO Office, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its capabilities, focusing on building robust analytical frameworks and performance monitoring tools from the ground up.

This hands-on position requires a proactive and detail-oriented individual who thrives on creating structure and driving meaningful change. While business decisions will remain the responsibility of underwriters, you will serve as a critical voice in influencing underwriting strategies and supporting data-driven decision-making processes. Your contributions will be instrumental in optimizing portfolio performance, enhancing risk management practices, and aligning operations with strategic objectives.

As the CUO Office evolves, this role offers the potential to expand its scope and contributes to the development of a team that will further enhance the organization’s portfolio analytics capabilities. This is an exciting chance to make a lasting impact on the organization’s success and shape the future of portfolio analytics within a dynamic and globally connected environment.

Location: This position will be based preferably out of our Zurich office, but potential candidates might also sit in our other European office locations in Paris, Milan, Cologne or Munich. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environment where our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.

Our business, your impact, our opportunity

What You’ll Be Doing


Portfolio Performance Analysis: Regularly evaluate underwriting performance, identify trends, and analyze profitability, risk quality, and portfolio composition to drive growth and improvement. Prepare quarterly and ad-hoc performance reviews for leadership.
Underwriting Portfolio Steering: Refine risk appetite, recommend strategies for growth or remediation, support underwriting plans, and monitor execution against targets.
Risk Aggregation & Management: Analyze risk accumulation across perils and geographies, monitor exposure limits, and integrate data into reinsurance and capital modeling.
Catastrophe & Scenario Analysis: Conduct catastrophe loss scenarios, assess tail risks, and support stress testing, capital planning, and reinsurance structuring.
Pricing & Profitability Support: Collaborate with pricing teams to analyze rate adequacy, validate assumptions, and recommend underwriting and renewal actions.
Predictive Analytics: Develop predictive models and leverage advanced analytics to support underwriting automation and decision-making tools.
Reporting & Dashboards: Create executive dashboards, automate underwriting metric reporting, and provide data-driven insights for decision-makers.
Reinsurance Strategy Support: Provide exposure and performance data to inform treaty and facultative decisions and improve retention strategies.
Regulatory & Capital Requirements: Support regulatory filings, collaborate on risk assessments, and align portfolio decisions with capital efficiency.
Innovation & Technology: Pilot AI models, integrate new data sources, and drive digitization of portfolio management processes.


What You’ll Bring

This role requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of commercial insurance, strong analytical capabilities, industry expertise, and a passion for driving innovation to optimize portfolio performance and deliver value to internal and external stakeholders.


Advanced degree in Finance, Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field
Minimum 5 to 10 years of experience in commercial insurance, with a focus on large corporate industry portfolios.
Strong knowledge of underwriting principles, risk aggregation, catastrophe modeling, and reinsurance structures.
General understanding of insurance product coverages, resulting exposures and their triggering portfolio impacts.
Proficiency in data analytics tools and predictive modeling (Python or R)
Expertise in regulatory compliance (e.g., Solvency II, NAIC), capital modeling, and risk management.
Proven leadership and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and executive management.
Innovative and investigative mindset with experience in leveraging technology, advanced analytics, and digitization for portfolio optimization
Natural curiosity with a drive to uncover insights and understand underlying patterns
