Are you looking for your next opportunity?

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a Lead, Portfolio and Performance Analytics in our newly established CUO Office team for Continental Europe.

Reporting directly to the Chief Underwriting Officer (CUO) for Continental Europe, this role offers a unique opportunity to lay the groundwork for a central function that supports portfolio monitoring and sustainable profitability across Sompo’s commercial insurance operations in Continental Europe. As a foundational member of the CUO Office, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its capabilities, focusing on building robust analytical frameworks and performance monitoring tools from the ground up.

This hands-on position requires a proactive and detail-oriented individual who thrives on creating structure and driving meaningful change. While business decisions will remain the responsibility of underwriters, you will serve as a critical voice in influencing underwriting strategies and supporting data-driven decision-making processes. Your contributions will be instrumental in optimizing portfolio performance, enhancing risk management practices, and aligning operations with strategic objectives.

As the CUO Office evolves, this role offers the potential to expand its scope and contributes to the development of a team that will further enhance the organization’s portfolio analytics capabilities. This is an exciting chance to make a lasting impact on the organization’s success and shape the future of portfolio analytics within a dynamic and globally connected environment.

Location: This position will be based preferably out of our Zurich office, but potential candidates might also sit in our other European office locations in Paris, Milan, Cologne or Munich. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environment where our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.

Our business, your impact, our opportunity

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Portfolio Performance Analysis: Regularly evaluate underwriting performance, identify trends, and analyze profitability, risk quality, and portfolio composition to drive growth and improvement. Prepare quarterly and ad-hoc performance reviews for leadership.
  • Underwriting Portfolio Steering: Refine risk appetite, recommend strategies for growth or remediation, support underwriting plans, and monitor execution against targets.
  • Risk Aggregation & Management: Analyze risk accumulation across perils and geographies, monitor exposure limits, and integrate data into reinsurance and capital modeling.
  • Catastrophe & Scenario Analysis: Conduct catastrophe loss scenarios, assess tail risks, and support stress testing, capital planning, and reinsurance structuring.
  • Pricing & Profitability Support: Collaborate with pricing teams to analyze rate adequacy, validate assumptions, and recommend underwriting and renewal actions.
  • Predictive Analytics: Develop predictive models and leverage advanced analytics to support underwriting automation and decision-making tools.
  • Reporting & Dashboards: Create executive dashboards, automate underwriting metric reporting, and provide data-driven insights for decision-makers.
  • Reinsurance Strategy Support: Provide exposure and performance data to inform treaty and facultative decisions and improve retention strategies.
  • Regulatory & Capital Requirements: Support regulatory filings, collaborate on risk assessments, and align portfolio decisions with capital efficiency.
  • Innovation & Technology: Pilot AI models, integrate new data sources, and drive digitization of portfolio management processes.

What You’ll Bring

This role requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of commercial insurance, strong analytical capabilities, industry expertise, and a passion for driving innovation to optimize portfolio performance and deliver value to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Advanced degree in Finance, Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Minimum 5 to 10 years of experience in commercial insurance, with a focus on large corporate industry portfolios.
  • Strong knowledge of underwriting principles, risk aggregation, catastrophe modeling, and reinsurance structures.
  • General understanding of insurance product coverages, resulting exposures and their triggering portfolio impacts.
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and predictive modeling (Python or R)
  • Expertise in regulatory compliance (e.g., Solvency II, NAIC), capital modeling, and risk management.
  • Proven leadership and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and executive management.
  • Innovative and investigative mindset with experience in leveraging technology, advanced analytics, and digitization for portfolio optimization
  • Natural curiosity with a drive to uncover insights and understand underlying patterns

  • Expansive Health & Wellness Benefits
  • Generous Retirement & Savings Plans
  • Global Parental Leave & Adoption Assistance

Expert Partners.

Clarity in complexity.

Unwavering commitment.

Building on Sompo Holding’s 135 years of innovation, we seek to deliver a unified approach to servicing and providing customized solutions for our clients, ensuring that we meet their needs effectively and consistently.

We strive to strengthen engagement with our clients and business partners every day by using the in-depth knowledge and insights of our experts to swiftly navigate the ever-shifting risk landscape in a fast and agile way – providing them with the products and coverages they need – underpinned by exceptional levels of service.

Title: Staff Research Scientist- Interactive Avatars
Description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About The Role

As a Staff Research Scientist, you will join a team of 40+ researchers and engineers in our R&D department, working on the frontier of generative AI with a focus on avatar-centric, interactive video diffusion models.

This is a unique opportunity for experts in machine learning and diffusion models to shape the future of AI video agents that listen, respond, and react like humans. As part of our Interactive Avatars team, you'll build models that hold natural, real-time conversations: understanding what a user says and how they say it, then responding with appropriate turn-taking, backchannels, gaze, and facial and body reactions. You'll join a team that moves fast, iterates often, and turns breakthrough research into product capabilities that ship.

What you'll do


Set the research direction and roadmap for dyadic interaction modeling, balancing long-term bets with near-term product impact.
Advance the state of the art in the perceptual layer of interactive agents, including understanding user audio and video and generating contextually appropriate reactions.
Post-train multimodal models to generate rich, natural dyadic interactions from user audio and video inputs.
Adapt diffusion models to new conditioning signals, such as conversational state, turn-taking, and listener cues.
Build robust evaluation frameworks and test suites for continuous tracking of interaction quality.
Partner with our data team to define data needs and shape high-quality datasets.
Lead and mentor a small group of researchers, and drive technical decisions across research, data, and engineering.


What We're Looking For


Deep ML expertise and extensive hands-on experience with diffusion models, ideally for video or avatar generation.
A strong publication record at top-tier venues (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH) in areas such as world models, dyadic interaction, or video diffusion, or equivalent demonstrated impact.
Experience leading a small team of researchers and mentoring junior members.
A track record of taking research from idea to production.
Proficiency in PyTorch and modern ML tooling for large-scale training.
Clear communication of hypotheses, experiments, and results, and the ability to influence direction across teams.


Nice to have


Experience with real-time or streaming generation, including autoregressive video diffusion.
Distillation or other techniques for low-latency inference.
Audio-driven facial, gesture, or full-body motion modeling.
Conversational modeling, such as turn-taking, backchanneling, or listener-response generation.


Why join us?

We’re living the golden age of AI. The next decade will yield the next iconic companies, and we dare to say we have what it takes to become one. Here’s why,

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

Serving 50,000+ customers (and 50% of the Fortune 500)

We’re trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald’s and more. Read stories from happy customers and what 1,200+ people say on G2.

Proprietary AI technology

Since 2017, we’ve been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Our AI technology is built in-house, by a team of world-class AI researchers and engineers. Learn more about our AI Research Lab and the team behind.

AI Safety, Ethics and Security

AI safety, ethics, and security are fundamental to our mission. While the full scope of Artificial Intelligence's impact on our society is still unfolding, our position is clear: People first. Always. Learn more about our commitments to AI Ethics, Safety & Security.

The good stuff...


Competitive compensation
Hybrid work setting with an office in London, Zurich, Munich, or remote in Europe.
25 days of annual leave + public holidays
Great company culture with the option to join regular planning and socials at our hubs
+ other benefits depending on your location


You can see more about Who we are and How we work here: https://www.synthesia.io/careers

Title: Site AI Partner (f/m/d)
Description:
Job Description Summary

Located in the heart of Switzerland, our Oberentfelden facility is a global center of excellence for High-Voltage Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS). As a critical hub within GE Vernova’s Grid Solutions business, we specialize in the design, assembly, and rigorous quality testing of advanced GIS systems ranging from 72.5kV up to 175kV.

Our site plays a vital role in the global energy transition. By providing robust, reliable, and innovative grid infrastructure, we enable our customers to integrate renewable energy sources, enhance grid stability, and ensure a sustainable power supply. We combine Swiss engineering precision with cutting-edge technology—such as eco-friendly SF6-free (g3) gas solutions—to set the standard for safety, efficiency, and performance in high-voltage energy transmission

Click here to know more about us: https://www.gevernova.com/electrification/product-overviews/ge-vernova-site-video-oberentfelden

,As Site AI Leader (f/m/d), you serve as the primary AI and machine learning (ML) partner for your site, turning real operational challenges into working solutions. You identify where AI creates the most value, guide teams through proof-of-concept (POC) development, and help scale those solutions into production.

Responsabilities

Job Description


Collaborate closely with the different functions, lean teams and stakeholders to proactively identify and evaluate high-impact opportunities for AI/ML applications at site level.
Act as a key AI partner to cross-functional project teams, guiding them through the potentials and limitations of AI/ML to effectively address specific business challenges. Translate business challenges into clear problem statements, measurable success criteria, and value hypothesis.
Act as a key partner for the site to leverage the AMP 2.0 possibilities. Coach the different teams and guide them through the different functionalities to develop own use-cases.
Drive the proof-of concept (POC) development for high-impact opportunities at site level and in close cooperation with the Power Transmission (PT) Central AI team, to quickly run feasibility tests or adapt existing use-cases for the site business needs.
Partner with the PT central AI team and other stakeholders to scale AI POC to production scale deployments and activate the business impact of the AI solution at site level.


What You´ll Bring


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or relevant experience
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML to operations (e.g., data analysis, time-series forecasting and anomaly detection, computer vision for quality/inspection, optimization, and basic NLP/LLM use cases).
Proficiency with Python and data analysis methodologies; practical experience with data collection, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimental POC design.
Ability to work effectively and collaboratively within diverse, cross-functional teams at site and PT level
Good communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear, concise documentation
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical challenges
Good understanding of project management principles, including agile methodologies, to drive projects from concept to completion


What We Offer


Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international and future-oriented environment
A permanent and secure employment contract
Flat hierarchies and a pleasant working atmosphere and corporate culture
A high degree of flexibility and independent work – for us, the result counts


Benefits Available To You

GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. In order to meet this mission, we provide varied, competitive benefits to help support our workforce.


Our compensation & benefits are designed to help you manage your personal and family needs, while rewarding high performers. We offer a robust benefits package depending on your employment status and your national requirements.
A healthy, balanced lifestyle can mean different things to different people. We've created programs that support the way you live and work today.
GE Vernova invests to provide opportunities to grow your career by providing a path for continued on-the-job learning and development.


Inclusion & Diversity

At GE Vernova, we believe in the value of your unique identity, background and experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture, where everyone feels empowered to do their best work because they feel accepted, respected and that they belong. Title: Sr. Scientist - Computational & Applied AI
Description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations (gRED and pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS-CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

Within this newly established Center of Excellence, our activities operate across a distinct continuum of innovation and explainability. The Computational Biology and Medicine team stands as the vital final link in this continuum. Focussed on our delivery for the portfolio we bridge advanced algorithmic models with deep mechanistic validation to turn AI-driven hypotheses into validated therapeutic targets and deepen our understanding of disease biology and our patients.

The Opportunity

The Senior Computational and Applied AI Scientist within the Computational Biology and Medicine team is responsible for developing and deploying translational and applied AI frameworks to accelerate our Immunology and Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism (CVRM) portfolios. Operating at the final stage of translational execution for Discovery and Early Development, you will focus on moving beyond pure statistical correlation toward a systems-level, mechanistic understanding of disease and target biology. This position offers a trajectory of professional development aligned with scientific excellence and modern enterprise productivity frameworks ensuring our computational pipelines directly optimize R&D throughput and compress discovery cycles.


Working across departments to co-develop and implement advanced machine learning models focused on explainable and causal AI methods (such as causal models, symbolic regression, and counterfactual inference) to map disease pathways and unlock true mechanistic target validation
Adaptation and fine-tune state-of-the-art biological foundation models to predict novel therapeutic targets in complex immune diseases and CVRM
Bridging the translational gap by implementing adversarial domain adaptation and cross-species translation algorithms to dynamically align animal model phenotypes with human patient endotypes
Leveraging patient-level multi-omics, spatial profiles, and real-world clinical datasets to identify distinct disease endotypes, defining mechanistic patient selection criteria that enable clinical scientists to stratify responder vs. non-responder populations
Constructing dynamic representations and physics-informed models (e.g., Neural ODEs, PINNs) to capture physiological kinetics, temporal disease progression, and patient "digital twins" entirely in silico
Applying graph-based deep learning approaches, building and querying large-scale biological knowledge graphs to capture systems-level interactions across complex tissue-remodeling and auto-inflammatory networks
Anchoring the final stage of the organizational continuum, translating algorithmic innovations and "ML-ready" frameworks directly into high-value portfolio deliverables
Collaborating cross-functionally with clinical scientists, wet-lab disease biology experts, biostatisticians, and enterprise engineers across pRED and gRED to convert ambiguous therapeutic questions into concrete computational pipelines
Ensuring provenance and explainability is an integral feature of your insight delivery to stakeholders


Who you are


You hold a PhD (preferred) or MSc in Computational Biology, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Bioinformatics, Systems Biology, Artificial Intelligence, or a highly quantitative field
You bring 3+ years (Senior Scientist) or 6+ years (Principal Scientist) of post-doctoral or biopharmaceutical industry experience delivering applied AI and data science solutions in a drug-discovery setting
You possess hands-on experience applying causal inference toolkits, graph neural networks, or generative models to high-dimensional biomedical data (single-cell, spatial omics, or clinical trial datasets)
You possess experience adapting large-scale biological foundation models or building dynamic systems models to capture temporal disease progression
You demonstrate an active interest or deep domain understanding of human immunology, complex and multifactorial diseases, or system-level pathophysiology
You exhibit elite communication and teamwork skills, with a proven track record of acting as a cross-functional catalyst between pure computational engineers and wet-lab experimentalists


This position is based in Basel, Switzerland

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Title: Sr. Specialist, Decision Intelligence (m/f/d)
Description:
Job Description

Position Overview - Basic Functions & Responsibility

Digital is the multiplier that will allow Development Sciences and Clinical Supply (DSCS) to deliver better experiments faster, efficient filing and launch, more robust supply chains and higher-confidence decisions across the portfolio. The DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) organization is tasked with the mission to pioneer and deploy innovative digital technologies that drive the acquisition, automation and utilization of data to enhance insights, efficiency, and quality of DSCS processes and methods.

The DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) organization within our Research Team is accountable for driving the digital transformation, data architecture, and technology solutions that enable execution and operations within the DSCS organization.

The Senior Specialist, Decision Intelligence is a technical role responsible for developing advanced analytics and operations research capabilities to enable data-driven decision making and inform DSCS business operations. This role will focus on modeling, simulation and optimization frameworks to solve complex business problems.

The Senior Specialist, Decision Intelligence Will


Support the translation of business problems into mathematical models for business process simulation and optimization.
Buildrobust and sustainable analytics that can be seamlessly integrated with WebApps and/or Agents to streamline user interaction.
Develop and implement probabilistic forecasting and stochastic optimization techniques to enable strategic decision making given uncertainty.
Serve as a business analyst to support business cases for new digital capabilities. Define and track KPIs aligned with the value proposition for digital transformation within DSCS.
Contribute to designing, building, and implementing modern data foundations and pipelines.
Contribute to the development of custom web applications (WebApps) that allow business users to seamlessly interact with data products and model outputs.
Work strategically across the DSCS Digital Technologies team to streamline routine work through advanced automation and AI tools.
Contribute to the advancement of the DDT Decision Intelligence Strategic Roadmap, developing reusable components that support decision intelligence capabilities across business domains.


Primary Activities


Requirements Translation: Translate business processes and/or stakeholder requirements into accurate mathematical representations and technical specifications for corresponding models, agents and data products.
Decision Intelligence Strategy: Translate data and model outputs into clear, concise and interpretable business insights. Collaborate with Digital Operations Change Management and functional area SMEs to define and implement AI-enabled decision making processes across DSCS.
Business case development: In collaboration with DSCS SMEs, develop the business case and articulate the value proposition for new digital capabilities.
Performance monitoring: Define and track KPIs to monitor the value realized through digital transformation within the DSCS organization.
Modeling & Simulation: Develop mathematical models to simulate and/or optimize business processes using techniques including but not limited to machine learning, discrete event simulation and optimization.
Data Engineering: In collaboration with the Digital Operations Shared Services team, build and optimize scalable data pipelines leveraging Databricks, Python, Dataverse, and advanced SQL. Transform raw data into contextualized, AI-ready data products.
Agentic AI: In collaboration with Agentic Intelligence team, test and implement agentic AI workflows using tools like Copilot Studio to automate decision-making processes and generate proactive business insights.
Web Application Development: In collaboration with Digital Operations Shared Services team, develop and deploy user-friendly WebApps to support interaction with data and analytics.
Development & Code Management: Utilize modern development environments (VS Code) and AI coding assistants (Cline) alongside GitHub for robust version control of scripts, applications, and data models to ensure code quality.
Systems Architecture: Work closely with system architects to ensure scalable, secure, and efficient DevOps.
Documentation & Enablement: Document processes, code, mathematical models, data models, and system architectures; provide training and technical support to end-users as new digital capabilities are rolled out.


Required Skills And Qualifications


Experience: 3+ years in data science, operations research, data engineering or a related highly technical role.
Pharmaceutical development and/or clinical supply chain experience strongly preferred. Understanding of CMC development across modalities (ie small molecule, large molecule, vaccine) preferred.
Core Technical Stack: Strong expertise in Python. Experience building and deploying advanced machine learning models. Databricks and MLOps experience preferred.
Business Analysis: Proven track record of gathering complex requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translating them into actionable, technical roadmaps.
Agentic AI & Automation: Familiarity with or strong interest in Agentic AI and integrating AI agents into workflows.
DevOps & Developer Tools: Proven experience with GitHub for version control. Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development tools like Cline. Proficiency working in VScode or other equivalent integrated development environment. Experience deploying apps or agents preferred.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex business challenges and translate them into mathematical problem statements and corresponding technical solutions.
Collaboration & Influence: Demonstrated ability to develop strong, trust-based relationships to execute priorities with a diverse group of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Independence: Independent decision-making abilities with a proactive approach to delivering results.


Education And Skills


Education: Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of experience in Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, or comparable technical field

Title: Principal Machine Learning Scientist, Frontier Research, AI for Drug Discovery (AIDD)
Description:
The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Opportunity

Frontier Research is dedicated to foundational machine learning research and developing new algorithmic frameworks. We operate with a flat scientific structure in which senior scientists define their own research agendas, and leaders act as mentors who shape priorities across the organization. We view open science as a core value and a competitive necessity. Our commitment to open dissemination, academic engagement, and community contribution ensures that our work contributes meaningfully to the broader machine learning community and advances the scientific ecosystem. In biology, many exciting research questions cannot yet be addressed with off-the-shelf ML approaches—they demand not only novel solutions but also new ways of framing the questions themselves, often beyond existing ML paradigms. We believe that the field of generative modeling provides the most promising paths to connect these fields and build robust, impactful solutions.

In this role, you will:


Develop theoretical frameworks and algorithms for sampling and generative modeling.
Contribute to publications and present your results at internal and external scientific conferences.
Collaborate and execute on research that pushes forward the state of the art in machine learning.
Directly contribute to experiments, including designing experimental details, writing reusable code, running evaluations, and organizing results.
Work with a large and globally distributed team.


Who You Are


You have a PhD in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, or related disciplines with 2-7 years of relevant work experience.
You have a strong publication record in generative modeling, with publications in academic journals like JMLR and at peer-reviewed ML conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and COLT).
You have strong communication and collaboration skills.


Preferred:


Published work with theoretical contributions.


Relocation benefits are NOT available for this opportunity

This position must be based in South San Francisco, New York City, or Basel

The expected salary range for this position in California is $201,300 - 373,800. For New York City, the expected salary range is $192,500 - 357,500. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst based in Switzerland.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will transform complex gaming and player data into actionable insights that drive product performance, user engagement, and business growth. You will work at the intersection of data analytics, statistics, and data science, helping teams understand player behavior and uncover opportunities for product improvement. Through advanced analytical techniques, experimentation, and predictive modeling, you will identify key performance drivers and support data-informed decisions. You will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product Managers in a highly technical, data-driven environment. Your work will contribute to improving gaming experiences, validating product hypotheses, and developing innovative analytical solutions. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a product-oriented mindset and a passion for turning data into measurable business impact.

Accountabilities


Analyze large volumes of game and player data to identify patterns, trends, behavioral dynamics, and opportunities for business growth.
Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations for product improvements, helping stakeholders understand what works, what does not, and where to focus next.
Conduct in-depth investigations into performance anomalies, game features, and changes in player behavior to determine underlying causes and explain their business implications.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product Managers to develop hypotheses, validate assumptions, and contribute to hands-on data science and machine learning tasks.
Apply statistical analysis and causal inference techniques to identify the factors influencing user behavior and product performance.
Support predictive model development and validation through feature engineering, dataset preparation, model evaluation, and A/B testing.
Design and implement experiments, evaluate their results, and provide statistically sound recommendations to support product decisions.
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance monitoring tools that help stakeholders track key performance indicators and make informed decisions.
Define and refine metrics for new products and features, translating high-level business requirements into measurable analytical frameworks.
Communicate complex analytical results clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Leverage AI coding assistants and other AI-powered tools to automate repetitive tasks, improve analytical workflows, and enhance the quality and efficiency of deliverables.


Requirements


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative discipline.
At least 5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or Data Scientist, preferably within the gaming, iGaming, or technology industry.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to uncover meaningful insights and translate data into clear business recommendations.
Experience working with large-scale datasets and distributed data processing technologies such as BigQuery, Spark, Hive, or equivalent tools.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, data transformation, and data wrangling.
Strong Python skills and practical experience with data science libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn.
Proficiency in data visualization and dashboard development using tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Solid knowledge of experimental design, statistical testing, A/B testing, hypothesis testing, and confidence intervals.
Working knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised learning, feature engineering, model training and validation, and evaluation metrics.
Familiarity with causal inference and uplift modeling, along with practical experience contributing to machine learning workflows or model development in collaboration with Data Scientists.
Experience using AI coding assistants or other AI tools in daily work to improve automation, productivity, and output quality.
English proficiency at B2 level or above.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to diverse audiences.
A proactive, product-oriented mindset and the ability to move beyond reporting metrics to recommend solutions that deliver measurable impact.


Nice To Have


Knowledge of the iGaming industry and an understanding of slot game mechanics.
The ability to evaluate games from the player's perspective and connect behavioral data with the overall gaming experience.
A strong product mindset, with an emphasis on identifying opportunities and proposing practical, impact-driven solutions.


Benefits


Flexible working hours and a remote-first working arrangement.
25 working days of annual vacation.
15 sick leave days.
One paid day off to celebrate your birthday.
Paid Ukrainian national holidays.
Medical insurance after successfully completing the three-month probation period.
A dedicated budget for professional development and education.
Company-funded individual English lessons.
Technical equipment tailored to your role and working needs.

Description:
Are you looking for your next opportunity?

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a Lead, Portfolio and Performance Analytics in our newly established CUO Office team for Continental Europe.

Reporting directly to the Chief Underwriting Officer (CUO) for Continental Europe, this role offers a unique opportunity to lay the groundwork for a central function that supports portfolio monitoring and sustainable profitability across Sompo’s commercial insurance operations in Continental Europe. As a foundational member of the CUO Office, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its capabilities, focusing on building robust analytical frameworks and performance monitoring tools from the ground up.

This hands-on position requires a proactive and detail-oriented individual who thrives on creating structure and driving meaningful change. While business decisions will remain the responsibility of underwriters, you will serve as a critical voice in influencing underwriting strategies and supporting data-driven decision-making processes. Your contributions will be instrumental in optimizing portfolio performance, enhancing risk management practices, and aligning operations with strategic objectives.

As the CUO Office evolves, this role offers the potential to expand its scope and contributes to the development of a team that will further enhance the organization’s portfolio analytics capabilities. This is an exciting chance to make a lasting impact on the organization’s success and shape the future of portfolio analytics within a dynamic and globally connected environment.

Location: This position will be based preferably out of our Zurich office, but potential candidates might also sit in our other European office locations in Paris, Milan, Cologne or Munich. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environment where our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.

Our business, your impact, our opportunity

What You’ll Be Doing


Portfolio Performance Analysis: Regularly evaluate underwriting performance, identify trends, and analyze profitability, risk quality, and portfolio composition to drive growth and improvement. Prepare quarterly and ad-hoc performance reviews for leadership.
Underwriting Portfolio Steering: Refine risk appetite, recommend strategies for growth or remediation, support underwriting plans, and monitor execution against targets.
Risk Aggregation & Management: Analyze risk accumulation across perils and geographies, monitor exposure limits, and integrate data into reinsurance and capital modeling.

Natural curiosity with a drive to uncover insights and understand underlying patterns

Title: Quantitative Modelling Specialist (Life & Health)
Description:
We are looking for an experienced quantitative modelling specialist to develop and enhance SCOR's Internal Capital Model for Life & Health (L&H) risks. The role combines quantitative risk modelling with production-quality Python development and offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of insurance, data and software engineering.

As a leading global reinsurer, SCOR offers its clients a diversified and innovative range of reinsurance and insurance solutions and services to control and manage risk. Applying "The Art & Science of Risk," SCOR uses its industry-recognized expertise and cutting-edge financial solutions to serve its clients and contribute to the welfare and resilience of society in around 160 countries worldwide.

Working at SCOR means engaging with some of the best minds in the industry - actuaries, data scientists, underwriters, risk modelers, engineers, and many others - as we work together to find solutions to pressing challenges facing societies.

As an international company, our common culture is defined by "The SCOR Way." Serving both to build momentum that drives the Group forward and as a compass to guide our actions and choices, The SCOR Way is anchored by five core values, reflecting the input of employees at all levels of the Group. We care about clients, people, and societies. We perform with integrity. We act with courage. We encourage open minds. And we thrive through collaboration.

SCOR supports inclusion and the diversity of talents, and all positions are open to people with disabilities.

The successful candidate will bring strong quantitative and programming capabilities, sound software-engineering judgement and either existing knowledge of L&H insurance risks or a demonstrated ability to quickly develop expertise in new and complex domains.

Key responsibilities:

Methodology: Enhance and maintain SCOR's Internal Model methodology with a focus on L&H risks and dependencies with other risks.
Software engineering & implementation: Design, develop and maintain robust, reliable and computationally efficient Python implementations of Internal Model methodologies, helping shape the architecture of the L&H modelling framework and applying sound software-engineering principles to ensure code quality, maintainability, scalability and performance.
Model changes & governance: Perform model change impact assessments, contribute to methodological enhancements, maintain technical documentation and support cross-functional model development initiatives.
Results analysis & communication: Analyse, visualise and communicate model results to internal stakeholders, with a particular focus on the drivers of L&H capital requirements.
Collaboration: Collaborate with colleagues across Risk Management, Finance, L&H Business Units and Data/AI in Paris, Dublin, Zurich and Cologne.

Your profile:

Several years of relevant professional experience in risk modelling, actuarial modelling, quantitative modelling or a related quantitative discipline.
Strong Python programming skills and experience developing and maintaining large object-oriented applications, with a good understanding of software architecture, code quality and maintainability.
Ability to translate quantitative methodologies into robust, efficient and maintainable software solutions and to improve the performance and scalability of modelling applications.
Knowledge of Solvency II, the Swiss Solvency Test, IFRS17 or L&H insurance risks is an advantage.
Solid quantitative background in mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, engineering, computer science or a related discipline.
Analytical mindset, proactive attitude and strong communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in an international, multidisciplinary environment.

Title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
Description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On


Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.
Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.
World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.
Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.
Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.


Who We're Looking For

A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

Your Background


PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues.
Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.
Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare.
Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale.


Nice to Have


Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting.
Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning.
Robotics or embodied AI.
Simulation for data generation.


What we offer


Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.
Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.
Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.
Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.
Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package
Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na transformação de dados em insights e soluções que apoiem decisões estratégicas e gerem impacto para o negócio.

Essa pessoa será responsável por explorar e analisar grandes volumes de dados, desenvolver modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, identificar padrões e oportunidades e trabalhar em parceria com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Principais responsabilidades


Explorar, tratar e analisar grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados.
Desenvolver análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos para apoiar decisões de negócio.
Construir, avaliar e aprimorar modelos de Machine Learning.
Definir métricas e acompanhar a performance dos modelos desenvolvidos.
Identificar padrões, tendências, correlações e oportunidades nos dados.
Transformar problemas de negócio em problemas analíticos e propor soluções orientadas por dados.
Criar dashboards, relatórios e apresentações para comunicar resultados de forma clara para diferentes públicos.
Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Engenharia de Dados, Produto, Tecnologia, BI e áreas de negócio.
Realizar experimentos e testes de hipóteses, incluindo testes A/B quando aplicável.
Documentar análises, metodologias, modelos e resultados.
Acompanhar a evolução de técnicas, ferramentas e boas práticas de Data Science e Inteligência Artificial.
Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven da organização.


Requisitos


Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática, Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência com análise e tratamento de dados.
Domínio de Python e bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy e Scikit-learn.
Conhecimento de SQL.
Conhecimentos de estatística e probabilidade.
Experiência com técnicas de Machine Learning supervisionado e/ou não supervisionado.
Capacidade de interpretar resultados e traduzi-los em recomendações de negócio.
Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similares.
Boa capacidade de comunicação e apresentação de resultados.


About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Title: Analista de Cientista de Dados Pleno
Description:
Company Description

A Experian é uma empresa global de dados e tecnologia que impulsiona oportunidades para pessoas e empresas ao redor do mundo. Atuamos em diversos mercados, como serviços financeiros, saúde, automotivo, agronegócio, seguros, entre outros. A Experian investe em pessoas e em novas tecnologias avançadas para liberar o poder dos dados. Contamos com uma equipe incrível de 25.200 colaboradores em 32 países.

Nossa singularidade é valorizar a sua. A cultura da Experian, centrada nas pessoas, inclusiva e orientada por propósito, é reconhecida por diversos prêmios — incluindo World’s Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Top 25 global da Fortune) e Great Place To Work™ em 26 países, entre outros. Confira o Experian Life nas redes sociais ou explore nosso site de carreiras para entender o porquê. A Experian também se orgulha de ser uma empregadora que promove igualdade de oportunidades e ação afirmativa.

Job Description


Desenvolver e evoluir modelos preditivos de propensão a pagamento, recomendação de ofertas e precificação de descontos, utilizando dados comportamentais, financeiros e históricos de negociação.
Conduzir experimentos e testes A/B para validar hipóteses relacionadas ao produto, jornada do cliente, comunicação e estratégias de oferta.
Construir e aprimorar pipelines de dados e engenharia de features em parceria com os times de Engenharia de Dados.
Aplicar técnicas analíticas e de machine learning para gerar insights que impulsionem a performance do produto e os resultados do negócio.
Traduzir análises e resultados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis para as áreas de Produto, Growth e Risco.
Monitorar e acompanhar métricas-chave do produto, identificando oportunidades de otimização e crescimento.
Atuar de forma colaborativa com squads multidisciplinares, contribuindo para decisões orientadas por dados e evidências.
Garantir a qualidade e a confiabilidade dos dados utilizados nos modelos e análises, apoiando a evolução contínua das estratégias e soluções do negócio.


Qualifications


Experiência em Growth, Produto, Ciência de Dados ou áreas analíticas.
Forte orientação a dados, pensamento analítico e capacidade de transformar informações em insights de negócio.
Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL para extração, tratamento e análise de dados.
Experiência com ferramentas de visualização e Business Intelligence, como Power BI, Tableau ou similares.
Vivência na condução e interpretação de testes A/B e iniciativas de experimentação.
Conhecimento de métricas de negócio, funis de conversão e indicadores de performance.
Formação superior em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência com Python para análise de dados, modelagem estatística e desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas.
Conhecimento em técnicas de Machine Learning, incluindo regressão, árvores de decisão e algoritmos de boosting.
Capacidade de comunicar análises e resultados complexos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Familiaridade com ambientes de nuvem, como AWS, GCP ou Azure.
Experiência prévia em produtos de crédito, cobrança, recuperação de crédito ou credit scoring será considerada um diferencial.


Additional Information

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Title: CIENTISTA DE DADOS PLENO II
Description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na transformação de dados em insights e soluções que apoiem decisões estratégicas e gerem impacto para o negócio.

Essa pessoa será responsável por explorar e analisar grandes volumes de dados, desenvolver modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, identificar padrões e oportunidades e trabalhar em parceria com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Principais responsabilidades


Explorar, tratar e analisar grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados.
Desenvolver análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos para apoiar decisões de negócio.
Construir, avaliar e aprimorar modelos de Machine Learning.
Definir métricas e acompanhar a performance dos modelos desenvolvidos.
Identificar padrões, tendências, correlações e oportunidades nos dados.
Transformar problemas de negócio em problemas analíticos e propor soluções orientadas por dados.
Criar dashboards, relatórios e apresentações para comunicar resultados de forma clara para diferentes públicos.
Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Engenharia de Dados, Produto, Tecnologia, BI e áreas de negócio.
Realizar experimentos e testes de hipóteses, incluindo testes A/B quando aplicável.
Documentar análises, metodologias, modelos e resultados.
Acompanhar a evolução de técnicas, ferramentas e boas práticas de Data Science e Inteligência Artificial.
Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven da organização.


Requisitos


Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática, Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência com análise e tratamento de dados.
Domínio de Python e bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy e Scikit-learn.
Conhecimento de SQL.
Conhecimentos de estatística e probabilidade.
Experiência com técnicas de Machine Learning supervisionado e/ou não supervisionado.
Capacidade de interpretar resultados e traduzi-los em recomendações de negócio.
Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similares.
Boa capacidade de comunicação e apresentação de resultados.


About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. About the job Nosso time de Data está em busca de um/uma Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em São Paulo, SP de forma Híbrida e suas principais atividades estarão relacionadas à resolução de problemas de negócio por meio de análises avançadas, modelos estatísticos e soluções de Machine Learning que gerem impacto mensurável para a companhia.

  • Conduzir iniciativas de Ciência de Dados de ponta a ponta, desde a identificação da oportunidade até a implementação e adoção da solução;

  • Formação superior em áreas quantitativas, Ciencia de Dados, Engenharias, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Remote Work | REF#303846
Description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.

Senior Data Scientist at BairesDev

In this role, you'll apply statistical modeling and feature engineering to cybersecurity and vulnerability-risk data. You'll build analytical pipelines in Python and SQL that turn raw security data into actionable insights. This is your opportunity to apply core data science skills to a high-stakes domain, working closely with engineering and leadership teams to improve how risk is understood and prioritized.

What You'll Do


Apply statistical modeling and feature engineering to cybersecurity and vulnerability-risk data.
Build analytical pipelines using Python and SQL for large-scale data analysis.
Improve risk prioritization through data-driven modeling and insights.
Communicate findings clearly to both engineering and leadership audiences.


What We Are Looking For


5+ years of experience in data science or quantitative analytics.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for building analytical pipelines.
Experience with statistical modeling and feature engineering.

Title: CONSULTOR(A) CIENTISTA DADOS I
Description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Somos uma empresa multinacional brasileira, referência global no desenvolvimento de soluções sustentáveis e inovadoras, de origem renovável. Cultivamos árvores e, por meio de tecnologia, transformamos o que vem da natureza em produtos que fazem parte do dia a dia de milhões de pessoas.




As árvores estão no centro do nosso propósito: renovar a vida a partir da árvore e construir um futuro cada vez mais sustentável para o planeta e para as pessoas.




Temos mais de 100 anos de história, e hoje, somos a maior fabricante de celulose do mundo, uma das maiores produtoras de papéis da América Latina e líder no segmento de papel higiênico no Brasil. Nossos produtos estão no dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas, em mais de 100 países.

Estamos presentes em diferentes momentos com produtos como papel higiênico, guardanapos, papéis para imprimir e escrever, papéis para embalagens, copos e canudos, feitos a partir de matéria-prima de fonte renovável.

Você pode nos reconhecer por marcas como Neve®, Pólen®, Suzano Report® e Mimmo®, entre outras. Quanto às unidades, estamos no Brasil e também em países como Argentina, Áustria, China, Coreia do Sul, Equador, Estados Unidos, Holanda, Israel e Singapura, com unidades administrativas e operacionais.

E, tudo isso só é possível por causa das pessoas da Suzano: somos cerca de 56 mil colaboradores(as) próprios(as) e terceiros(as), além de profissionais em nossos escritórios internacionais.

Juntos, trabalhamos diariamente para plantar um futuro melhor para o planeta e para as pessoas. Fazemos isso criando produtos sustentáveis a partir do cultivo do eucalipto, que é plantado e colhido por nós.

#VemSerSuzano.







NOSSO JEITO DE TRANSFORMAR




Aqui, conectamos pessoas, estratégia e tecnologia para transformar o negócio.

Trabalhar nesse contexto é atuar próximo das decisões, impulsionando resultados e soluções globais de forma cada vez mais sustentável.

Mais do que apoiar processos, você constrói soluções, influencia caminhos e promove a evolução da companhia, atuando junto e pelo todo.




SEU DIA A DIA NA COMO CIENTISTA DE DADOS EM REVENUE - UNPE




Conduzir análises exploratórias, diagnósticas e preditivas, integrando dados internos e externos para gerar insights para o negócio.
Desenvolver e evoluir modelos analíticos e preditivos, com foco em mercado, demanda, preços e suporte à tomada de decisão.
Identificar oportunidades de aplicação de dados, analytics e inteligência artificial que gerem valor para a organização.
Interpretar resultados e comunicar insights de forma clara e objetiva, transformando dados em recomendações e planos de ação.
Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e produtos analíticos para acompanhamento de indicadores, tendências e previsões.
Liderar projetos estratégicos junto às áreas de negócio e à alta liderança, evidenciando impacto e geração de valor.
Definir e disseminar metodologias, processos e boas práticas analíticas, garantindo governança, rastreabilidade e reprodutibilidade.
Atuar em parceria com equipes de Dados e Tecnologia para garantir qualidade, disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos dados e soluções.
Contribuir para a evolução do ecossistema de dados e analytics, promovendo automação, escalabilidade e robustez das soluções.
Comunicar benefícios, limitações e oportunidades dos produtos analíticos e digitais para diferentes públicos e níveis de senioridade.

O QUE ESPERAMOS PARA ESSA JORNADA?




Formação Superior Completa;
Sólida Experiência profissional em Ciência de Dados, com foco em: Modelagem estatística e Machine Learning, Análise exploratória de dados e Gestão de modelos de IA Generativa
Domínio em Python (bibliotecas para análise, modelagem e automação);
Domínio em boas práticas de programação, arquitetura de dados e governança;
Vivência em Big Data e Cloud (Google BigQuery e Azure DevOps);
Inglês em nível avançado será um diferencial;
Boa comunicação para traduzir análises técnicas em insights claros para diferentes públicos;
Desejavel experiencia com Chatbot e Agentic AI;
Desejavel experiencia com modelos de otimização.

Description:
Sobre nós 

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 25 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

>> Sobre a vaga:

Esta vaga é direcionada a profissionais de todos os níveis de experiência dentro da trilha de analistas que desejam atuar como cientistas de dados na XP Inc., desde o nível assistente até o sênior.

Somos um lugar formado por pessoas que sonham grande, focamos em aprendizado constante em um ambiente com muita liberdade para que você possa criar e deixar a sua marca. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Desafios Que Você Vai Encontrar Por Aqui


Ambiente dinâmico e aberto para novas ideias;
Liberdade para trilhar uma carreira protagonista;
Espaço para desenvolvimento e aprendizado constantes.


O que buscamos e principais responsabilidades

Como cientista de dados, com apoio do centro de excelência de Data Science & Machine Learning, essa pessoa será responsável por construir produtos de dados para otimizar tomada de decisão na companhia, como modelos de classificação/regressão, otimização de heurísticas e análises estatísticas.

Principais Responsabilidades


Realizar estudos e análises com grande volume de dados para embasar decisões estratégicas;
Desenvolver uma variedade de modelos de aprendizagem de máquina para resolver problemas específicos e otimizar processos;
Participar e conduzir reuniões com stakeholders para alinhar expectativas e comunicar resultados;
Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de diferentes áreas (como engenharia, marketing e produto) para entender as necessidades do negócio e traduzir essas necessidades em soluções baseadas em dados.
Realizar testes e validações rigorosas dos modelos e soluções implementadas, assegurando a qualidade e a confiabilidade dos resultados.


Pré-requisitos Para Candidatura


Ter a nossa cultura
Conhecimento prático em Python, com experiência na construção, treinamento e avaliação de modelos de machine learning.;
Conhecimentos em estatística, probabilidade, técnicas de modelagem estatística, aprendizado de máquina, otimização e sistemas de recomendação;
Capacidade de analisar problemas complexos e desenvolver soluções baseadas em dados, abordando questões de negócios com uma mentalidade analítica;
Paixão por tecnologia e inovação, com interesse ativo em acompanhar tendências e as melhores práticas da área de ML;
Habilidade de comunicação para interagir com diferentes áreas, stakeholders e cientistas de dados;
Residir em São Paulo e possuir disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido (3x na semana);


Diferencial


Experiência prática em Databricks
Conhecimento e vivência na manipulação e análise de dados financeiros, com a capacidade de extrair insights relevantes para o setor;
Conhecimento prático do framework Kedro, com experiência em sua aplicação para estruturar e gerenciar projetos de ciência de dados de forma eficiente;
Experiência com modelos de otimização linear

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando um profissional para desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e previsões que otimizem atividades associadas ao ciclo de conta corrente. Este profissional será responsável por monitorar a performance, estabilidade e eficiência dos modelos, realizando ajustes e garantindo a aderência às regulamentações internas e melhores práticas do mercado.

Desenvolver, implantar e aprimorar modelos estatísticos para todo o ciclo, desde a abertura até a gestão da conta corrente, tanto para PF quanto para PJ, garantindo precisão, estabilidade e alinhamento com as áreas de negócios e resultados.

Transformar a dor de negócio em solução técnica, alinhar as expectativas das áreas demandantes e apresentar os resultados com linguagem não técnica.

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:


Experiência em ciência de dados, modelagem estatística e análise de dados.
Familiaridade com dados, métricas e modelos relacionadas a processos bancários, especialmente abertura de contas e gerenciamento de produtos associados.

Experiência em DataBricks e Azure.

Title: Cientista de Dados Sênior
Description:
Olá, somos a Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional! ⭐

Nós acreditamos no poder de transformação de vidas por meio da educação de qualidade e excelência! Aqui, nós buscamos conectar diferentes pessoas para que possam construir um mundo melhor a partir da educação, com muito trabalho, respeito e dedicação, proporcionando a melhor experiência e apoiando a jornada do conhecimento de mais de 500 mil alunos.

A Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S/A é um dos maiores e mais representativos grupos de educação do país, tendo instituições de ensino academicamente relevantes e marcas reconhecidas em suas respectivas regiões, das suas escolas de ensino básico às instituições de ensino superior.

Docentes e colaboradores de diversas áreas trabalham em sintonia para garantir essa construção diária. E estamos sempre em busca de novas pessoas para colaborar com esse objetivo, sejam profissionais que procuram por uma primeira oportunidade no mercado de trabalho, até os mais experientes.

Você se identifica e acredita nesse propósito e quer trabalhar em uma de nossas marcas? Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Estamos de braços abertos para recebê-lo(a).

Para se candidatar a uma de nossas vagas, é importante manter todos os seus dados atualizados e completos. Fique à vontade para se cadastrar em todas as vagas disponíveis do seu interesse, apenas recomendamos que você finalize um processo antes de iniciar um novo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados Nível 3 para desenvolver modelos estatísticos, preditivos e de recomendação que apoiem decisões acadêmicas e de negócio, como permanência de alunos, personalização de trilhas, collection score, lead score e eficiência operacional. A pessoa atuará com autonomia na condução de projetos de ponta a ponta, em parceria com a liderança técnica de ML e com as áreas de negócio.

Responsabilidades


Investigar problemas de negócio e transformá-los em hipóteses testáveis, com desenho experimental e métricas claras de sucesso.
Conduzir análises estatísticas e testes de hipóteses, escolhendo entre abordagens paramétricas e não paramétricas de acordo com as características dos dados.
Desenvolver, treinar e avaliar modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo fine-tuning de modelos pré-treinados e uso de AutoML para acelerar a experimentação.
Construir redes neurais com Keras para problemas de classificação, regressão, séries temporais e representação (embeddings).
Projetar e evoluir sistemas de recomendação utilizando redes neurais, Multi-Armed Bandits (MAB) e métodos bayesianos com Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), equilibrando exploração e aproveitamento em cenários reais.
Planejar e analisar testes A/B e experimentos online, comunicando resultados com rigor estatístico.
Colaborar com engenharia de ML e MLOps no deploy, monitoramento, detecção de drift e retreino dos modelos.
Aplicar práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA adotadas pelo time, como Spec-Driven Development (SDD), revisão crítica de código gerado por IA e cumprimento dos critérios de aceite antes do merge.
Garantir qualidade, explicabilidade, ausência de vieses e conformidade com a LGPD, com as diretrizes do CNE e com o Referencial do MEC para uso de IA na educação.
Apoiar o desenvolvimento de pessoas menos experientes por meio de revisões técnicas e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
Comunicar resultados, premissas e limitações dos modelos a públicos técnicos e não técnicos.



Requisitos obrigatórios


Mais de 3 anos de experiência em ciência de dados, com modelos entregues em produção ou com impacto mensurável no negócio.
Sólida base de estatística: inferência, testes de hipóteses paramétricos e não paramétricos, intervalos de confiança e desenho de experimentos.
Experiência com modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo validação, seleção de métricas, tuning de hiperparâmetros e AutoML.
Experiência prática com redes neurais em Keras e familiaridade com fine-tuning de modelos pré-treinados.
Experiência com sistemas de recomendação, incluindo abordagens com redes neurais e Multi-Armed Bandits.
Conhecimento de métodos bayesianos e MCMC (por exemplo, com PyMC).
Domínio de Python e SQL, e de bibliotecas atuais como pandas, scikit-learn e Keras.
Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e noções de MLOps, como rastreamento de experimentos com MLflow ou similar.
Experiência com nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
Boa comunicação e capacidade de traduzir análises em recomendações de negócio.



Diferenciais


Experiência em educação, EdTech ou dados acadêmicos.
Experiência com séries temporais, NLP ou modelos de linguagem.
Experiência com Vertex AI ou plataformas equivalentes de ML gerenciado.
Conhecimento de processamento distribuído (Spark) e de bancos de dados analíticos.
Experiência com inferência causal e uplift modeling.
Mestrado ou doutorado em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Matemática ou área correlata.



Requisitos e qualificações

Escolaridade: Superior Completo

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho:

09h às 19h (Seg à Sex) 220h

Title: Data Scientist - Collection
Description:
About CloudWalk

About CloudWalk: We are not just another fintech unicorn. We are a pack of dreamers, makers, and tech enthusiasts building the future of payments. With millions of customers and a hunger for innovation, we're now expanding our neural network - literally and metaphorically. At CloudWalk, our Collection team owns recovery across every product we offer, from lending and chargebacks to acquiring debts and credit card. We run several collection flows in parallel, and our credit card business is scaling fast. We are looking for a Data Scientist to design the strategies, analyses, and models that make collection smarter and more effective, starting with credit card and expanding to other collection fronts over time. If you love turning messy data into decisions that move real money, this role is for you.

About This Role


Own credit card collection intelligence. Design strategies, analyses, and models built specifically for our credit card portfolio.
Build decision models. Develop and improve models such as propensity to pay, risk segmentation, and treatment and channel optimization to drive collection actions.
Turn data into strategy. Analyze collection performance, design experiments, and translate findings into concrete changes in policies and flows.
Ship to production. Partner with engineering and operations to put models and rules into production and monitor their performance over time.
Expand the scope. Collaborate with the team's lending modeling work and take on other collection fronts as the business grows.
Use AI as a practical accelerator for analysis, coding, and operations, not only as a chat assistant.


What You Need To Succeed


Hands-on experience with collection, credit, or credit card portfolios.
Strong analytical mindset: you break down messy problems with data and reach clear, actionable conclusions.
Experience building statistical and machine learning models that drive business decisions.
Fluency in Python and SQL, with proficiency in libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, or similar.


Nice to Have


Experience with experimentation (A/B tests, champion/challenger strategies) and causal inference.
Experience deploying and monitoring models in production.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (GCP/BigQuery or AWS) and version control (Git).
Experience with LLMs and Agents.
Builder and proactive mindset: you take ownership and create solutions, not just reports.
As a member of a fully remote and distributed team, you are expected to complete tasks autonomously, being highly collaborative and self-driven.
Ability to communicate effectively in both English and Portuguese.


The Future We See

The Future We See: At CloudWalk, we envision a future where AI empowers every field to reach new heights:


People teams leveraging AI to transform talent acquisition and employee development.
Marketing professionals creating data-driven, AI-powered campaign strategies.
Customer Success teams enhancing client experiences with intelligent solutions.
Risk analysts combining human expertise with AI to navigate complexities.
Designers collaborating with AI to push creative boundaries.


Join us at CloudWalk, where we're not just engineering solutions; we're building a smarter, AI-driven future for payments—together.
